[Active - Press] Finality: Erases every entity in range, including the caster. Non-player entities are killed and discarded; players are killed.

Records every life the user has lived and uses karma after death to begin the next reincarnation.

Passive
[Passive] Reincarnation: On death, the user reincarnates into a random race, losing all EP and skills except Nirvana. Reincarnation has a chance to grant an extra temporary Unique Skill that is not carried over on future deaths.

[Passive] Life Archive: Stores all of the user's past lives as records, including their EP and skills.

[Passive] Karma Accumulation: On death, the user gains karma based on what they achieved in their past life. Time alive, EP, acquired or mastered skills, powerful kills, long survival, and strong subordinates can all contribute.

Active
[Active - Press] Migration: Opens the Life Archive, allowing the user to view past lives and their EP and skills. The user can spend karma to unlock sub-modes of old skills and use them in the current life. If every sub-mode of a skill is unlocked, the skill is fully recovered.

The authority of life's shade, recording corpses, commanding the dead, and entering a battle stance that heals allies while corroding enemies with life force.

Passive
[Passive - On Learn] Grave Authority: Improves attack damage, attack speed, movement speed, knockback resistance, Presence Sense, and Chant Speed.

[Passive - Toggle] Grave Archive: Grants Naberius Will, Naberius Vision, and Presence Sense, while removing fear, insanity, hypnosis, mind control, burden, webbed, movement interference, and spatial blockade effects.

[Passive - Toggle] Corpse Recording: While toggled, killed enemies are stored in the archive with their HP, EP, Spiritual Health, count, and skills.

[Passive - Toggle] Servant Command: Active summons automatically attack enemies that hit the user or enemies the user attacks.

[Passive - Toggle] Grave Revival: Dead active summons can revive; repeated revivals of the same summon become more expensive.

[Mastery - Passive] Death Veto: While Naberius is toggled, lethal damage is denied, leaving the user alive and granting brief invulnerability, Haki Coat, and Instant Regeneration.

[Mastery - Passive] Corpse-King Authority: Grants Resistance Degradation and a chance to automatically dodge projectiles.

Active
[Active - Press] Grave Archive: Opens the archive menu, allowing the user to select stored corpses, reduce their count, delete them, manifest them, or clear active summons.

[Active - Press] Manifest: Raises selected archive entries as servants. Normal use summons one of each selected corpse; crouching summons as many selected stored copies as possible.

[Active - Press] Chimera Creation: Opens the chimera menu, consuming archived life records to create a stronger servant.

Modes
[Mode] Crimson Eden Warform: Switches from Grave Archive stance into War Stance. This stance strengthens health, attack, defense, speed, recovery, senses, and dodge-related abilities, replacing archive and summon modes with Life Deity combat abilities.

[War Stance] Genesis Pulse: Releases a life-force pulse that heals the user, restores resources, cleanses major mental and movement debuffs, empowers nearby allies, and causes the land nearby to bloom.

[War Stance] Spirit War Step: Dashes forward with spiritual force, damaging enemies ahead, applying Life Seizure, stealing resources, and healing the user based on enemies hit.

[War Stance] Samsara Bloom: Releases a close-range life-and-death burst. Damage increases based on missing HP, applying Organ Decay and Life Seizure, pulling enemies inward, and stealing resources.

[War Stance] Eden of the Life Deity: Hold to charge a divine life domain. While charging, allies are healed and restored; on release, enemies are damaged, pulled inward, afflicted, and drained, while allies, subordinates, summons, and owned mobs are empowered.

[War Stance] Deathless Life Siphon: Marks a target, deals heavy life-force damage, steals resources, and can execute weakened targets with a revive-skipping kill.

[War Stance] Bestow One Life: Grants one forbidden extra life to the user or an ally. When consumed, the target survives lethal damage and gains healing, brief invulnerability, Instant Regeneration, and Haki Coat.

[War Stance] Subordinate Evolution: Force-evolves allied summons, subordinates, tamed mobs, or Naberius servants, improving health, attack, movement, size, resources, and combat power.

[War Stance] Force Awakening: Forces a valid player target through Demon Lord or True Hero awakening.

[War Stance] Fruit of Life: Creates a Fruit of Life. Eating it grants temporary immunity to normal damage, though damage that bypasses invulnerability can still ignore it.

Changes the user's form, allowing them to become a creature far weaker than themselves.

Active
[Active - Press] Morph: Transforms the user into the selected mob. The target must be far weaker than the user.

[Shift + Active] Undo Morph: Cancels the current transformation and restores the user's original form.

A kingly authority over endless imprisonment and time-devouring hunger, weakening enemies, stealing skills, and trapping targets in inescapable space.

Passive
[Passive] Endless Growth: Increases skill learning, mastery progress, and EP gain.

[Passive - Toggle] Magicule Theft: When hitting a player, has a chance to steal part of their temporary Magicules.

[Passive - Toggle] Desperate Empowerment: The lower the user's health becomes, the stronger their strength grows; at critical health, incoming damage is also reduced.

[Passive - Toggle] Endless Pressure: Nearby targets are afflicted with slowness, weakness, and blindness.

[Passive - In Slot] Infinite Prison: Attacks briefly inflict Infinite Imprisonment on the target.

Active
[Active - Press] Taker's Will: Gradually lowers the target's health. Magic Resistance or Magic Nullification reduces the effect.

[Active - Press] Power Hunger: Copies some of the target's skills. Intrinsic, Resistance, Nullification, Common, and Extra skills can be copied, with a chance to copy multiple skills at once.

[Active - Press] Room: Creates a small room-like field. Entities inside are afflicted with a stronger Infinite Imprisonment effect.

[Active - Hold] Isolation: After staring at a target, temporarily disables all of their skills.

[Active - Press] Divine Lifesteal: Deals spatial and holy damage to nearby entities. Matching resistances reduce the damage, while matching nullifications can ignore it.

The authority of the Lord of Time, freezing projectiles, rewriting durations, rewinding self and targets, and detonating enemy Temporal Debt into judgment.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Chrono Divinity: Enhances movement, attack, flight, and chant speed, while granting senses, dodge power, and resistance degradation. Mastery adds Law Degradation and Space Resist Degradation.

[Passive - Toggle] Temporal Isolation: Regularly removes harmful effects from the user. Mastery strengthens the cleansing.

[Passive - Toggle] Projectile Infinity: Stops enemy projectiles before they reach the user. With Mastery, projectiles can be frozen, redirected, or reflected.

[Passive - Toggle] Chrono Prediction: Predicts enemy movement and attacks, creating rejected-future afterimages. With Mastery, threatening enemies are slowed and marked with Future Rejection.

[Passive - Toggle] Stolen Duration: Extends the user's beneficial effects, shortens harmful effects on the user, and weakens enemy buffs nearby.

[Passive - Toggle] Sovereign Time Authority: Enemies that look at, rush, or approach the user are slowed and gain Temporal Stutter and Temporal Debt.

[Passive - Toggle] Chronology Denial: With Mastery, lethal damage can be denied by rewinding the user to an older recorded state.

[Passive - Combat] Temporal Debt: Hitting enemies stores delayed time damage on them. Many Istaroth abilities consume or multiply this stored debt.

Active
[Active - Press] Chronicle: Scans nearby timelines and reports marked enemies, total Temporal Debt, and looped targets. Crouching stores a Manual Anchor for later self-rewind.

[Active - Press] Time Skip: Teleports forward, freezes projectiles along the path, damages enemies in the skipped line, and applies Temporal Stutter and Temporal Debt.

[Crouch + Active] Momentum Theft: Stops projectiles, falling blocks, and enemies in front of the user, stealing their momentum and launching the user forward.

[Active - Press] Borrowed Seconds: Steals duration from enemy buffs, extends enemy debuffs, strengthens the user's buffs, and reduces Istaroth waiting time.

[Crouch + Active] Eternal Moment: Freezes the user's beneficial effects in place, repeatedly extending them for a short time.

[Active - Press] Stillness of the King: The user enters stillness, greatly reducing incoming damage and storing blocked damage as pressure. When stillness ends, nearby enemies are damaged by the stored pressure.

[Crouch + Active] Object Permanence: Freezes a targeted entity, projectile, or falling block in place. Living targets are action-locked and gain Temporal Debt.

[Active - Press] Rewind Self: Restores the user to a Manual Anchor or recent snapshot, restoring position, health, resources, Spiritual Health, and removing harmful effects.

[Crouch + Active] Rewind Target: Rewinds a target to an older position or state. Allies can be restored, while enemies are punished with Temporal Stutter, action lock, and Temporal Debt.

[Active - Press] Delayed Verdict: Marks a target and stores damage they take. When the timer ends, stored damage plus Temporal Debt detonates as Timeline Verdict.

[Crouch + Active] Effect Before Cause: Damages a target before the cause occurs, applying Future Rejection and heavy Temporal Debt.

[Active - Press] Twenty-Second Causality Loop: Records nearby enemies, then plays their timeline backward, repeatedly snapping them to previous positions and adding Temporal Debt.

[Crouch + Active] Condemned Repeat: Anchors a target to one moment. If they move too far, move too fast, or try to escape, they are snapped back and punished.

[Active - Press] Future Exile: Removes a target from the current moment, making them invisible, frozen, and no-physics for a short time. When they return, they take damage and Temporal Stutter.

[Crouch + Active] Past Burial: Buries a target in their past, locking actions, applying Event Silence, and adding Temporal Debt.

[Active - Hold] World of Still Seconds: Creates a stopped-world field around the user. Enemies, projectiles, and falling blocks are frozen, slowed, silenced, rejected from the future, and loaded with Temporal Debt.

[Active after Holding] Clockbreak Release: Releases the stopped world, detonating frozen force, projectiles, held time, and Temporal Debt into a large causality explosion.

[Mastery - Active] Last Second of Creation: Declares the final second, forming a massive doom storm. Time accelerates violently, gravity dies, entities are lifted, projectiles freeze, enemies are silenced and rejected from the future, and the future collapses into a huge final detonation.

A parasitic skill that studies status effects, stores them as fungal samples, upgrades them, and spreads them to nearby enemies through poisonous spores.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Spore Aura: While toggled, the user periodically releases a fungal aura that affects nearby enemies. Enemies are inflicted with Paralysis, poisonous spores appear around them, and small mushroom patches may grow nearby.

If the user has stored analyzed effects, the aura releases additional poison spores. The more effects stored, the stronger the aura appears.

Active
[Active - Press] Analyze: Samples a random active effect from the target the user is looking at. Crouching analyzes the user instead. The sampled effect is stored in fungal memory; analyzing the same effect again increases its stored count.

[Active - Press] Workshop: Opens the Fungus Infection GUI, showing stored effects, upgrade state, available upgrade points, and the currently configured workshop effects.

[Active - Press] Configure: Creates a workshop loadout from stored effects. Normal users can configure fewer effects, while Mastery allows more. Crouching clears the workshop. The workshop determines which effects Spread can use.

[Active - Press] Spread: Spreads workshop effects to nearby enemies. Crouching applies effects to the user instead. Each use randomly selects effects from the workshop and applies them to nearby targets.

Upgrade
Each analyzed effect has its own stored count. Stored counts can be spent to improve that effect's duration or amplifier.

Workshop
The workshop is the selected list of effects that Spread can use. The GUI lets the player assign analyzed effects into workshop slots.

A cheat-like support skill that enhances exploration and combat, exploiting the world as if bypassing normal limits.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Utility Suite: Grants full bright vision, Magicule flight, fall protection, entity highlighting, auto-eating, and automatic totem handling. Some effects consume Magicules continuously or when triggered.

Active
[Active - Press] Xray Hack: Highlights ores, making underground resources easier to find.

[Active - Press] Kill-Aura: With Mastery, automatically aims at nearby entities for attacks.

Opens a domain of negation, empowering the user while suppressing non-allied entities within it.

Active
[Active - Press] Domain: Negation Field: Opens a field of black blocks near the user. Inside the domain, the user gains Strength, Resistance, Speed, and Regeneration.

Non-allied entities are afflicted with Anti-Skill, Weakness, and Slowness, and take continuous damage while inside.

A divine general's authority centered on adaptation, gradually mastering, nullifying, and countering threats after enduring them.

Passive
[Passive] Adaption: After being hit by a damage type, the user gradually gains resistance, nullification, bypass, and degradation against that type. Being afflicted by an effect grants immunity to it. Severance and cook effects can also be adapted to and countered over repeated exposure.

[Passive - Toggle] Adaption Usage: Toggles all gained effect immunities.

[Passive - Toggle] Infinite Regen: Provides continuous regeneration.

[Passive] Learning: Increases skill learning and mastery progress.

Active
[Active - Press] Sword of Extermination: Summons or resummons the Sword of Extermination.

[Active - Press] List Filter: Opens a filter list, allowing the user to enable or disable gained effect immunities.

The authority of the God of Conquest, using guilt as a resource to summon weapons, unleash calamities, and dominate the world through four Aspects.

Passive
[Passive] Guilt: Slowly builds guilt, which is used as a resource for the skill's other abilities.

[Passive] Rend and Split: Damage from this skill is difficult to block or resist.

[True Passive] Aspect: Grants the Aspect system. Different Aspects change how Caedros conquers, including Control, Famine, War, and Death.

Active
[Active] Fang and Serpent: Checks and uses guilt to perform an attack.

[Active] Conquest: Summons an ashen halberd. While holding it, the user can dash and sweep; using the skill again charges the weapon, then blasts enemies away in a forward cone with heavy damage.

[Active] Plague and Pestilence: Sweeps the surrounding area twice. Recasting teleports to the target and strikes them with heavy status-effect damage.

[Active] BANG!: After winding up, releases a devastating line attack forward, blowing away or erasing targets and terrain while dealing void damage.

[Active] Construct: Sweeps the nearby area. Targets killed by this move become weapons orbiting the user; these weapons automatically attack nearby enemies and generate guilt when they break.

[Active] Cloud the Skies: Consumes all guilt and charges, turning the world red. During this state, enemies are debuffed and the user is empowered. Enemies killed by Caedros during this period lose all skills.

Aspect
[Aspect: Control] Opens a control GUI and locks selected skills. Targets far weaker than the user are forced out of their bodies into spirit form, adding their EP to the user temporarily.

[Aspect: Famine] Attacks apply stacking debuffs and steal enemy buffs. When debuffs exceed a threshold, Famine triggers, draining resources over time and spreading infection, hunger, and resistance shutdown across the world.

[Aspect: War] Increases damage based on the user's Magicules. Weaker targets become Conquered, losing skills and regeneration while giving part of their EP to the user. If all enemies are conquered, Total War begins, massively empowering the user and changing BANG!.

[Aspect: Death] Movement and damage scale with souls. Souls can revive the user. Those who die in the realm have souls stolen and leave behind perfect replicas that follow the user.

Disrupts the battlefield by swapping positions, allowing the user, enemies, projectiles, or marked targets to instantly exchange places.

Passive
[Passive] IQ of 530K: Grants Thought Acceleration, and can grant Sage with Mastery.

[Passive - Toggle] Passive Mastery: Provides passive mastery progression.

[Passive - In Slot] Tough Guy: Grants Resistance and Strength while slotted.

Active
[Active - Press] Exchange: Swaps the positions of two entities. Normally swaps the user with the target they are looking at; crouching swaps two random entities in range.

[Active - Press] Target Select: Enters target selection. Punching entities saves up to three targets; using it while holding a projectile can save the projectile as a target. Exchange prioritizes these saved targets. Crouching clears all saved targets.

The authority of reflected judgment, reflecting damage, storing it, and releasing it all at the moment of truth.

Passive
[Passive - In Slot / Toggle] Mirrored Reality: When taking damage, directly reflects part of it and stores the rest as Reflection for other abilities.

[Passive - In Slot] Fate Inversion: While Mirrored Reality is active, lethal damage is inverted, preventing immediate death and clearing stored reflections.

Active
[Active - Press] Glass Prophecy: Marks an enemy with Foretold. While marked, part of the damage taken by the user is stored on that target as Reflection.

[Active - Hold] Mirrorfield: Creates a mirror domain around the user, continuously damaging targets within it and storing Reflection from the damage dealt.

[Active - Press] Moment of Truth: Consumes all collected Reflection, dealing reflected judgment damage to the related targets at once and clearing the stored collection.

Locks the user's state into a greedy moment and sustains Little King through a pseudo heart.

Passive
[Passive] Little King: While a pseudo heart is placed on a nearby entity, the user's HP, Spiritual Health, Magicules, Aura, EP, and effects are locked to the state they were in.

[Passive - Toggle] Prevention: Limits how long Lionheart can be maintained, preventing its backlash from escalating too far.

[Passive] Damage Greed: Grants resistance degradation and immunity to severance and cook effects. Mastery strengthens the effect.

Active
[Active - Hold] Lionheart: After charging, saves the user's current state and locks the user in that state while held. Maintaining it too long causes severe backlash to the user.

[Active - Press] Little King: Places a pseudo heart onto the subordinate the user is looking at, enabling Little King. The subordinate must be alive and within effective range.

The authority of the Lord of Space, intercepting projectiles, crossing dimensions, compressing space into attacks, and creating prisons that isolate targets.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Spatial Interception Field: When toggled on, a spatial interception field surrounds the user. Incoming projectiles are frozen by distorted space before they can hit.

Active
[Active - Press] Dimensional Shift: After setting a target dimension, teleports the user to that dimension. When crouching, the user can specify a player and teleport to that player's location instead.

[Active - Press] Spatial Cube Barrage: Compresses space into cube-shaped projectiles and launches them forward. Crouching fires more cubes.

[Active - Press] Cube Judgement: Calls spatial judgment from above, causing falling spatial cubes to strike enemies in an area. Crouching calls down more cubes.

[Active - Press] Prison Realm: Creates a spatial prison that isolates or captures a target. The target is removed from normal space and confined in a separate prison. If the prison loses its master or is released, the target returns to normal space.

[Active - Press] End of All Creation: Spawns a massive black hole that drags in entities, projectiles, items, and falling blocks, repeatedly damages living targets, and ends in a crushing collapse.

[Active - Hold] Destiny Beam: Hold to charge a destiny beam. Higher charge increases damage, radius, and active duration. When released, the beam fires forward and can be swept across enemies while active.

Senses nearby Magic Ore and reveals its location through blocks.

Active
[Active - Press] Magic Ore Scan: Releases an expanding scan that highlights nearby Magic Ore and Deepslate Magic Ore through blocks. Without Mastery, the scan has a 12-block radius, lasts 8 seconds, costs 2,500 Magicules, and has a 12-second cooldown. With Mastery, the radius increases to 20 blocks, the duration increases to 16 seconds, the cost is reduced to 1,500 Magicules, and the cooldown is reduced to 6 seconds. Each successful activation grants 1 Mastery point.

A sacred white formula that commands holy ice, using parallel clones to assist with casting and gathering before annihilating enemies with spear rain, a frozen domain, and the final ice phoenix.

Active
[Active - Press] White Formula: Grand Choir: Summons 2 permanent parallel clones, increased to 3 with Mastery; press again to dismiss all clones. Clones assist with parallel spellcasting. They can also accept an item as a gathering order, search for ores, mine, collect dropped items, return to the user, and perform some hunting tasks. Crouch and press to transfer the user's consciousness into the nearest clone. The original body remains behind as an AI-less Anchor Body. Use the mode again to voluntarily return. If the controlled clone dies, the user is forcibly returned; if the Anchor Body is destroyed, the player dies immediately. A voluntary return restores the user to 75% HP. Returning after clone death restores only 45% HP and removes 12% of maximum Magicules and 12% of maximum Aura. Costs 80,000 Magicules, reduced to 60,000 with Mastery. Cooldown: 1 second, reduced to 0.5 seconds with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Tenth Formula: Ice Barrier: Creates a moving ice barrier that follows the user, periodically dealing Ice damage and knocking back nearby enemies. While maintained, Water and Ice magic deal 1.6x additional damage, increased to 2x with Mastery; all magic deals 1.4x additional damage, increased to 1.75x with Mastery; and Chant Speed gains an additional 2, increased to 3 with Mastery. While active, lethal damage automatically revives the user once per in-game day. Revival restores 75% HP, Magicules, Aura, and Spiritual Health, clears harmful effects, grants 6 seconds of invulnerability and 12 seconds of Self-Regeneration and Haki Armor, freezes and knocks back nearby enemies, places every mode on a 15-second cooldown, and grants a strengthening effect for 120 seconds. Costs 60,000 Magicules, reduced to 45,000 with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Second Formula: Stellar Ice Spear Rain: Hold to charge and release to summon a massive rain of ice spears at the targeted position. The spears descend in a spiral; each impact damages enemies within roughly 5 blocks and applies Diamond Dust. Enemies already affected by Frost take 55% additional damage. Costs 85,000 Magicules, reduced to 65,000 with Mastery. Cooldown: 2.5 seconds, reduced to 1.75 seconds with Mastery.

[Active - Hold] Seventh Formula: Frozen Cathedral: Hold to charge and release to unfold a massive Frozen Cathedral around the user. The domain continuously produces high-frequency ice-spike damage. Costs 160,000 Magicules, reduced to 120,000 with Mastery. Cooldown: 5 seconds, changed to 18 seconds with Mastery.

[Active - Hold] Ice Blossom Final Formula: Apocalyptic Ice Phoenix: Hold to charge and release to send an ice phoenix diving toward the targeted position, followed by an enormous area-wide ice explosion. Costs 260,000 Magicules, reduced to 200,000 with Mastery. Cooldown: 10 seconds, reduced to 7.5 seconds with Mastery.

A silver formula of ice and water magic, creating ice clones that assist casting and using Diamond Dust to amplify later ice and water damage.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Split-Second Chant: Increases magic casting speed. Ice and Water magic gain a stronger casting speed bonus and deal more damage.

[Active - Toggle] Formula Succession: While active, Ars Weiss clones copy certain magic the user is about to cast and cast it as well. The copied spell uses the user's magic instance. With Mastery, continued magic keeps its full power.

[Passive - In Slot] Diamond Dust: Albis Vina attacks apply Diamond Dust. Targets with Diamond Dust take increased Ice and Water damage from the user. Mastery increases the bonus.

[Passive] Ice Sovereignty: Grants resistance to Ice and Water damage, and prevents the user from being slowed by their own ice effects.

Active
[Active - Press] Ars Weiss: Creates ice clones as dummy casting bodies. The clones copy the player's skin, but cannot attack normally, gain EP, or drop items, and disappear after a short duration. Mastery creates more clones and extends their duration. If a clone is destroyed, it bursts and applies Diamond Dust to nearby enemies.

[Active - Hold] Riville Calantibium: Fires a concentrated ice beam in the direction the user is looking. The beam pierces multiple targets, deals Ice damage, and applies Diamond Dust. If Ars Weiss clones are active, clones can also fire weaker beams from their own positions; with Mastery, all active clones can join.

[Active - Hold] Stellas Natea: Summons crystalline ice spears above the targeted area. The spears fall after a short delay, dealing Ice damage and slowing enemies hit. Targets with Diamond Dust are struck by an extra spear; active clones add weaker extra spears, and Mastery reduces the delay.

Learns from incoming attacks, gradually building the matching resistance and adapting to severance damage.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Adaption: When hit by any attack, gains a small amount of learning progress toward the matching resistance. If no matching resistance exists, builds damage reduction against that damage type, with a higher cap after Mastery.

[Passive - Toggle] Severance Adaption: After being hit by severance attacks multiple times, grants severance immunity and cancels future severance damage.

Active
[Active - Press] Summon Extermination Blade: Summons the Extermination Blade into the user's current inventory slot. It will not summon if a blade is already in the inventory or if the selected slot is occupied.

The authority of the Lord of Pestilence, elevating Fungus Infection into gray ooze, plague spread, and biomass absorption.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] The Gray Ooze Aura: The user emits ash-gray spores and mycelium. In combat, a living gray film coats the ground beneath them; enemies stepping onto it are afflicted with poison, corrosion, and fragility, which can stack through repeated exposure.

[Passive - Toggle] Biomass Absorption: When infected enemies take plague tick damage, part of their lifeforce is converted into biomass and returned to the user. The more infected targets are active, the stronger the user's regeneration becomes.

[Passive - Toggle] The Blight Carrier: Infected enemies become walking hazards. When they approach their allies, the plague jumps to clean targets, spreading poison, corrosion, and fragility through the enemy line.

Active
[Active - Press] Epidemic Sequencing Sweep: Works like Analyze, but scans an area to copy effects and gain more upgrade points.

[Active - Press] The Mutation Vault: Opens the Mutation Vault, functioning as an enhanced Workshop with more effect slots.

[Active - Press] Fungal Catalyst: Standing cast releases a wave of gray filth, applying slotted effects to nearby enemies. Crouching expands the wave, buffs the user with stored beneficial effects, and prevents stored debuffs from affecting the user.

[Active - Press] Fleshy Miscreations: Sacrifices part of the user's health and Magicules to tear away biomass and spawn fleshy doubles. These minions rush enemies and inject effects stored in the Mutation Vault. If they survive to the end, they dissolve and heal the user.

Enters Limbo at the cost of death, blindly choosing one skill owned by the direct killer and inheriting it permanently.

Passive
[Passive] Limbo: When the user dies, they enter a threshold space known as Limbo. A set of skill cards appears before the user, representing skills owned by the entity directly responsible for the user's death.

Card colors reveal only the skill tier:
Bronze: Common Skill.
Silver: Extra Skill or Intrinsic Skill.
Gold: Unique Skill.

[Passive] Blind Choice Restriction: The user may select only one card based on its color. The exact skill information associated with each card is completely hidden and cannot be identified, inferred, or revealed by bypassing the restriction in any way.

[Passive] Candidates and Inheritance: Only skills owned by the entity that directly killed the user enter the candidate list. At most one skill can be acquired from each death. After making a choice, the user revives at their respawn point and permanently acquires the selected skill.

[Passive] Enemy-Type Limit: For each enemy type, the user can enter Limbo through this effect at most once.

Usurp your enemies' Aura. Steal their abilities and control their skills, draining their power for your own use.

Passive
[Passive - While Equipped]: The player's attacks have a 50% chance to steal 1% of the target's Aura, restoring the player's depleted Aura.

Active
[Active - Press]: Overwrite: Copies one Battlewill skill from the target. Has a 25% success rate, increased to 50% when mastered. Each attempt costs 1,000 Magicules and has a 10-second cooldown.

Triples all physical capabilities, but can only be applied to opponents whose abilities are inferior to the user's.

[Press]: When targeting an opponent with lower EP than the user, attacking them will deal triple damage, including both physical and magical damage. The opponent's attacks against the user will also have their defensive resistance reduced to one-third, effectively allowing the user to withstand three times the normal damage.

Duration: 1 minute. After the duration ends, the skill enters a 120-second cooldown.

[Press]: Sends the player back to the moment when the world was first generated. The player's inventory, items, and other player data will be preserved. Only the world itself will be reset. This skill is disabled in multiplayer mode.

While possessing this skill, after killing a creature:

[Press]: Open the Summoning Panel and summon previously slain creatures. The number of Dark Avatars that can be summoned is limited to a maximum of 5. Once a Dark Avatar is killed or disappears, it cannot be summoned again and will be permanently gone. Killing a Dark Avatar will not grant the player EP or other rewards. Dark Avatars do not drop experience or loot.

By my barrier, I shall reverse the laws of your magicules, returning them to their elemental form. Thus, no magic shall be able to penetrate it.

Unlock Method: Master Anti-Magic Area to unlock Anti-Magic Barrier in its Learnable state.

Active [Hold]: Creates a magic field centered on the player that expands outward in all directions. Creatures inside the barrier will be restricted, while creatures outside cannot enter the magical barrier. Undead creatures within the barrier take 40 damage per second.

Cost: 1,000 Magicules per second.

A mysterious ritual that overturns the law of day and night, causing the holy and demonic to exchange places.

Acquisition:
Obtained when the player kills Luminous Valentine.

Active:
[Press]: Converts Majin Alignment into Holy Alignment, or Holy Alignment into Majin Alignment.

Cooldown: 1,800 seconds.

A mysterious ritual that overturns the law of day and night, causing the holy and demonic to exchange places.

Acquisition:
Master Reverser + possess Day-Night Inversion (will lose Day-Night Inversion).

Active:
[Press]: Converts Majin Alignment into Holy Alignment, or Holy Alignment into Majin Alignment.

Cooldown: 600 seconds.

Active
[Active - Hold] Soul Gluttony: Aim at a target and hold the skill key to devour its body, energy, and soul, converting the target into the player's MP, Magicules, or EP.
Powerful targets with more than 100 health must first be severely wounded, with only 10% health remaining, before they can be devoured.
Costs 5,000 Magicules. Both the individual and group modes have no cooldown (0 seconds).
Once mastered, killing enemies in the Nihility Collapse mode triggers Soul Gluttony, with strong penetration against barriers and Anti-Skill defenses.

[Active - Hold] Nihility Collapse: Hold the skill key to accumulate void energy. Longer charging increases the release strength, up to a maximum charge duration of 60 seconds. Release the key to unleash it.
While holding a weapon, damage equals the release damage + 10% of the weapon's damage.
Costs 50,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 300 seconds at full charge; partial charges scale the cooldown proportionally, rounded up to the next whole second.

[Active - Press] Imaginary Space: Provides 20 pages of storage, increased to 30 pages when mastered.

[Active - Press] Space-Time Domination: Use Shift + the skill key to switch sub-modes.
Instant Movement, Space-Time Connection (portal), and avatar teleportation all have a 5-second cooldown.
Mode A: Instant Movement
Move to a location within sight.
Move to the location of the player's avatar.
Mode B: Space-Time Connection

[Active - Press] True Dragon Release:
Mode A: Scorching Avatar
Attacks with fire and high-temperature skills.
Increases attack speed.
Strengthens scorching skills.
Suited to continuous attacks and fast combat.
Mode B: Storm Avatar
Attacks with wind, lightning, and storm skills.
Improves mobility.
Strengthens area attacks.
Suited to fighting groups.
Mode C: White Ice Avatar
Attacks with freezing and slowing skills.
Reduces enemy movement speed.
Strengthens defense.
Suited to controlling the battlefield.

[Active - Press] True Dragon Nucleation: Coming soon.

Passive
Multidimensional Barrier:
Provides resistance to physical attacks, immunity to fire, and resistance to elemental attacks.
Greatly reduces damage from physical attacks, elemental magic attacks, and projectile attacks.
Provides high damage reduction against Ultimate Skill attacks.

Active
[Active - Press] Scorching Dragon Release: Creates an independent avatar. Use Shift + the skill key to switch sub-modes.
Clone Mode: Switch control between the main body and an avatar, leaving a new avatar at the original location.
Fusion Mode: Recall an avatar, causing it to disappear.
Costs 50,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 60 seconds. Up to 5 avatars can be summoned; exceeding this limit replaces the earliest summoned avatar.

[Active - Press] Scorching Excitation:
Increases movement speed.
Increases attack speed.
Increases skill casting speed.
Increases fire and scorching damage.
Avatars summoned by Scorching Dragon Release receive the same enhancements.
Duration: 5 minutes. Cooldown: 300 seconds. Costs 10,000 Magicules.

[Active - Press] Dimensional Leap: Use Shift + the skill key to switch sub-modes.
Arrival Mode (avatars 1, 2, 3, 4, 5): Move from the main body's location to the selected avatar.
Swap Mode (avatars 1, 2, 3, 4, 5): Exchange the positions of the main body and the selected avatar.

Velgrynd's Help Grow friendship request: friendship ≥500, loyalty ≥500 and bond ≥1000; the player owns Alteration, either player or NPC owns an Uriel variant, the NPC owns Raguel, and the player's current EP is at least 2.4 million. Execution spends 2.4 million EP and directly attempts to grant Shub to the player, subject to normal acquisition cost. Cthugha goes to the NPC, consuming that NPC's Raguel and any Uriel variant it owns. On first acquiring Skill Storage, eligible permanent skills are recorded and removed from the active skill list; resistances stay, while magic, battlewill, external transfers, no-plundering skills and configured exclusions are exempt.

Azathoth's special automatic acquisition: master Raphael Wisdom and Beelzebuth, with default requirements of 100 named subordinates and 100 mastered skills; automatic evolution, Nightmare ultimates and God Skills must be enabled, configuration must allow it and god-class ownership must be available. Default EP requirement is 40 million with any owned True Dragon ultimate, otherwise 60 million; the MP threshold is max(0, 20 million − 5 million × owned True Dragon ultimates). Both prerequisite ultimates and all owned True Dragon ultimates are consumed, with the dragons recorded in Azathoth. A True Dragon ultimate is optional.

The default MP threshold is 3.4 million plus the default acquisition cost of the skill for each copied ultimate submode entry. On first acquiring Skill Storage, eligible permanent skills are recorded and removed from the active skill list; resistances stay, while magic, battlewill, external transfers, no-plundering skills and configured exclusions are exempt.

Store weakened creatures in a spirit realm and summon a fighting party within your command capacity.

Active
[Active - Hold] Absorb: The target must have at most 20% of its maximum health. Its normal maximum EP must not exceed 50% / 62.5% / 75% / 87.5% / 100% of the player's normal maximum EP across Baby Spirit Fox, Fox Spirit Envoy, Spirit Fox Contract Master, Mystic Fox Master and Heavenly Fox Sovereign. The target remains free to act during the channel. An incoming attack against the caster or target, loss of line of sight, a target distance greater than 5 blocks, or releasing the skill key interrupts the channel. Health, EP and all capture eligibility conditions are checked again on completion. Costs 500 magicules. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

[Active - Press / Hold] Summon: Select a stored creature, then hold to summon it. The five stages allow 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 8 active creatures and provide 6 / 9 / 12 / 15 / 18 command slots. Both limits apply. Normal maximum health when deployed, including cultivation growth and fox-race health bonuses but ignoring temporary weakening, determines slot cost: up to 50 costs 1 slot; above 50 and up to 200 costs 3; above 200 and up to 1,000 costs 6. Creatures above 1,000 cannot be deployed. A powerful creature costing at least 6 slots is limited to one active summon of the same entity type. If growth, a race change or reloading puts the party over its current limits, excess summons are automatically recalled to the spirit realm; stored creatures and cultivation progress are preserved. Summoning costs 50% of the creature's base magicules plus 25% of its accumulated cultivation EP. Cooldown: 5 seconds.

Passive
[Passive] Cultivation: Kill-based growth remains, but kills no longer restore full health. Leveling restores only the newly gained maximum health, leaving existing wounds intact. Further growth has diminishing returns as accumulated cultivation EP rises; at 100,000 cultivation EP, marginal growth is 50% of its initial value. Growth has no hard cap, and the resulting strength counts toward summon costs and command capacity.

[Passive] Damage Sharing: Spirit Fox Contract Master, Mystic Fox Master and Heavenly Fox Sovereign can redirect 30% / 40% / 50% of incoming damage to summons within 16 blocks. The player's damage is reduced only by the amount actually taken by the summons; any unhandled damage remains on the player.

Restrictions and Changes
Blacklisted creatures can never be captured. Recognized bosses without explicit compatibility are denied by default and require the dedicated boss allowlist to be enabled. The server's vanilla-only and maximum-health rules still apply. Special creatures from other mods that expose neither boss tags nor boss bars may require additional pack-specific restrictions.

This revision lowers the capture threshold from half health to 20%, restricts stronger targets and repeated powerful creatures, adds maximum-health-based command capacity, and reduces cultivation healing and damage sharing.

Assume a human form and release it at any time.

Active
[Active - Press] Cast: Costs 1,000 MP and adjusts body size and movement speed to Human Form.

[Active - Press] Release: Costs no MP. Removes this skill's body-size and movement-speed adjustments, restoring the size and speed determined by the current race and other effects. Cast again to re-enter Human Form.

Interaction and Changes
For slimes, the human-form state is synchronized when casting or releasing the skill. After release, logging in again or respawning does not automatically restore the released Human Form. This revision adds Release [Press]. Neither mode has a cooldown.

Design custom barriers by spending skill-provided points on modifiers.

Active
Barrier Creation opens the editor. Preset modes cast the assigned designs. Crouch + Barrier Creation repairs a barrier; crouch + a preset displays its current stats.

Makes created barriers stronger and more efficient. Barrier cooldowns are halved, and certain modifiers can be used without their usual skill requirements.

Active
Rho Aias raises a held shield. Barrier Float toggles a floating platform. Containment throws three rings at the target and seals its skills, magic and battlewill arts when it binds.

An administrator version of Barrier Arts, with its own preset designs and Barrier Creation editor. Its use requires operator permission; limits and available modifiers follow the server configuration.
Binds the target, preventing movement and the use of spatial skills. The binding can fail against a target that overpowers it or cannot be bound.
Creates a simple protective barrier around the caster. Crouching while looking at a friend allows the barrier to protect that target instead.
Casts a defensive wall in front of the caster.
Creates barriers for the caster alone, or for the caster and their allies. The available barrier HP is split between the protected targets.
Dispels a targeted barrier or supported binding. With the default configuration, Infinity Prison can only be removed after this magic is mastered.
Uses spatial magic to invade another owner's barrier when strong enough. It cannot invade anchor barriers or unique barriers, and cannot be initiated from inside the barrier.
Creates an unbreakable barrier while immobilizing the caster. With the default configuration it consumes 5% of maximum magicules per second. Other skills cannot be used while the casing is held.

Combat mechanics for Leon Cromwell.

Passive: Sword Guard
While able to fight and holding a sword in his main hand, Leon independently rolls a 70% guard chance for each physical hit from a player or another non-allied living attacker, fully negating that hit. Physical attacks follow Tensura's damage classification, including physical arrows fired by those attackers. Magic damage, environmental damage and allied attacks do not trigger sword guarding.

Guard Stance and Counters
Leon keeps his sword raised while pursuing an opponent and between attacks, looking for an opening. A successful guard during a sword attack preserves that attack and its contact timing, then he returns to his guard stance. Entering a contact guard interrupts charged casting. His existing magic and aura slash attacks do not interrupt an active defense sequence.
Contact motions include a frontal cross guard, a diagonal outward parry, a raised upper guard and a hanging guard, chosen randomly without consecutive repeats. The hanging guard raises his arm with the blade tip pointing down in front. Each complete contact motion lasts 0.60 seconds, followed by a 0.20-second walking interval with an upper-body sword guard before the next motion. Physical hits during these intervals retain their independent guard checks, metallic clashes, sparks and impact feedback without resetting the overall defense timer; direct melee attackers receive slight recoil. Leon pursues at a walking speed of 0.9 while defending and does not sprint.
A close opponent can be counterattacked only after at least two successful guards, at least three completed contact motions and at least 1.20 seconds of defense. Including the walking intervals, the earliest counter is 2.20 seconds after the first guard. The current contact motion must finish before the counter begins. With only one successful guard or an opponent too far away, Leon starts recovery after 2.40 seconds, retaining another 0.20 seconds of guarded pursuit and recovery. Each successful guard during this window still produces contact feedback.

Dodge
While guarding or between attacks, an incoming hit that was not guarded receives a 30% reactive dodge check. Leon steps left, right or back, avoids obstructed directions, and uses the same dash configuration, attributes and brief invulnerability rules as the player's V dodge. Defaults are a 1-second cooldown and 0.25 seconds of dodge invulnerability; the motion lasts 0.40 seconds. Dodge-bypassing damage and dodge-negation attributes remain effective. Sword swings are completed without repeatedly canceling attacks to dodge.

Attack Pace
Ordinary sword motions use a clock 1.6 times as fast, with synchronized impact timing. The cross combo shortens its wind-up and recovery while keeping 0.50 seconds between its two damage contacts so both cuts can land.

Changes
Retains an independent 70% guard chance per physical hit, all four contact motions and impact feedback. Complete contact motions now alternate with guarded walking intervals, and melee counters require at least three completed motions and two successful guards. Single-contact and distant cases use timed recovery. Leon walks while defending, repeated hits no longer refresh the overall defense duration, and his existing magic and aura slash attacks cannot take over the defense sequence.

Transforms your body, allowing your spiritual body to survive after your physical body dies.

[Passive, Toggle] Body Transformation
Physical death turns you into a spiritual body, which does not vanish when MP runs out. In spiritual form, you cannot use Aura or deal physical damage.

[Active, Press] Possession
While in spiritual form, aim at an eligible target and press the skill key to possess it. Regain physical form and inherit the target's physical attributes and body-related intrinsic skills.

Passive
Immune to poison.

[Passive, In Slot - Attack] Death Poison Creation
Attacks apply death poison without consuming MP. Base poison damage is twice that of Poison. The first application is guaranteed. Subsequent hits have a 5% chance to add a stack, up to 5 stacks; higher stacks increase poison damage. The initial duration is 30 seconds, and each successful additional stack adds 30 seconds.

[Weakness Identification - Hold]
Keep the same entity targeted for 3 seconds to complete the analysis, with Tensura casting progress displayed. Moving beyond analysis range or losing line of sight interrupts it. Costs 2,000 MP with no cooldown. The result is bound to that individual target for 30 seconds and shows a purple outline visible only to the caster. While it lasts, death poison applied to that target deals double damage and bypasses poison-immunity skills. Other entities of the same type must be analyzed separately.

[Death World - Hold]
Charge for 5 seconds with Tensura casting progress displayed as a connected pool of soft black-purple liquid gathers at your feet, then release automatically. Flowing patterns move across the continuous surface as its smooth edge spreads outward over the ground and follows steps in the terrain, reaching a radius of 100 blocks. The field lasts about 10 seconds; living entities that touch its liquid die immediately. The liquid fades out afterward. Costs 10,000 MP on successful release with a 60-second cooldown. Only the caster is exempt; other living entities, including allies, die on contact.

lang|greatsage|greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7..en: Shader rendering: a new face for the Sage
On by default. The Sage's console replaces the menu and every announce is redrawn. /gamerule sageShaderRendering false brings back the classic look.
Ceremonies as real scenes
Harvest Festival, Demon Lord Seed, Hero Egg, True Hero and the True Demon Lord awakening are now full-screen scenes with their own ambience. Nothing can hurt or push you while they play.
Raphael's evolution, remade
Rebuilt shot by shot from episode 35.
The Sea of Souls
A new reincarnation scene: draw your wishes above a lake of souls under the stars.
Skill fusion
When skills merge into a Unique or an Ultimate, they slam into your screen as anime skill cards, the screen shatters, and the shards come back together as the new skill.
Naming, as a cutscene

Name a monster and the camera pulls to the side: your magicules flow into it and it lights up as it absorbs them. Then the Sage reports the name, and the Voice of the World confirms its evolution. Players who get named see it from their side. Turn it off with namingScene in the client config.
Thought Acceleration (H)

With the Great Sage or Thought Acceleration, press H or say it: the world freezes into cold colors, sounds drag down, your heartbeat takes over and incoming projectiles show their path, red if it hits you. Solo: the whole world slows x5. Multiplayer: a 20-block bubble slows creatures and projectiles. 6 s, 40 s cooldown, both configurable.
Magic Sense (N)

With a sense skill such as Magic Sense, see the aura of every being, shaped like its body. Its color follows its alignment (violet Majin, white-gold Hero, red Chaos, green neutral), its size follows its EP and keeps growing: a massive aura in the distance means run. Tune it in Settings.
Growth comes faster
Experience gains x1.5, the first kill of a species counts as observing it, and items you hold for the first time are appraised.
Periodic analysis and skill modes
With TNO compatibility, analysis grants mastery periodically and no longer fills mode learning points. FoxAblaze Ultimate Raphael also counts as Great Sage.
Gamerules, clearer

needGreatSage is now announcementsRequireGreatSage: it only decides who gets the announcements. New: requireGreatSage (on by default). Turn it off and everyone can use the G menu, assess, voice commands and analyses without the Great Sage skill.
Clearer menus
Bigger buttons, the Sage's bubble no longer covers the pages, and a sealed class tells you to open it in the Growth tree.
Fixes

Reincarnation no longer hands out special addon Uniques, and addon resistances are no longer always Nuclear or Void. Assess bubbles no longer drift when flying, auras no longer get stuck in a capsule shape with some mods, and the freeze before animations is gone. Server admins get /greatsage xp. Voice commands now work with microphones that refuse 16 kHz, and the menu's background hum is much quieter. The Portuguese and Turkish voice models install properly, menu text no longer shows through confirmation windows, a full reset now gives every Unique Tensura owes you from the reset counter, and you no longer stay invulnerable after a rare reincarnation outcome.

lang|kaleidoscope_cookery|kaleidoscope_c.en: Cooking with the Stockpot
To cook with the stockpot, place it on a valid heat source.
First, add a soup base to the stockpot.
Next, add the required ingredients.
After adding all of the required ingredients, cover the stockpot with a stockpot lid.
Then, wait for a moment...
...and remove the lid.
The dish is ready!
Cooking with the Wok
To cook with the wok, place it on a valid heat source.
First, add some oil to the wok.
Next, add the required ingredients.
After adding all of the required ingredients, use the kitchen shovel to start stir-frying!
Then, after enough stirs and waiting for a moment...
...the dish is done!
Placing Steamers
To cook with steamers, place it on a valid heat source.
Then, place more steamers on top of existing ones to stack them higher...
...and higher and higher!
However, a single heat source can only provide heat for up to 8 steamers...
...so, be mindful of its limits!
Cooking with Steamers
From the top, insert ingredients into the steamer.
Steamers already containing ingredients can also be directly stacked.
After placing them, right click to cover the steamer and start steaming.
Then, wait for a period of time...
When the cooking is done, remove the steamer lid.
Finally, remove the steamers with the finished products layer by layer.
Using the Grease Crock
Open the grease crock lid to store oil.
You can grease your kitchen shovels using 1 portion of oil from the grease crock.
The greased kitchen shovel can be used to add oil to the wok.
Using the Millstone
Right-click with items in hand to insert them into the millstone.
Items dropped on the millstone from above will also be automatically inserted.
Certain creatures can be placed near the millstone to be harnessed.
After which, the millstone will start processing the items.
After one full rotation, the items are transformed into products and ejected from the opening.
Cooking with the Shawarma Spit
Ingredients can be placed into both the upper and lower layers of the shawarma spit.
Each layer can hold up to 8 smeltable food items of the same type.
Provide a redstone signal to activate the spit and start cooking.
Then, wait for a period of time...
...and the cooking is done!
However, it burns if the food is removed with bare hands from an activated shawarma spit.
A safer method is to use a kitchen knife to remove the food...
...or to deactivate the shawarma spit before attempting to remove the food.
Recording Recipes
When there are ingredients inside a wok or stockpot, right click with a blank recipe to record its contents.
At a later time, right click the wok or stockpot with the recipe again. This will add all of the recorded ingredients on the recipe using items from your inventory.
Kitchen Basics
Embark on the path of the culinary master!

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.thermosei.en: A high-tech heart implant that converts movement and vibrations into energy, powering itself and recharging its internal batteries.
Explosions do not harm the user and instead grant a stack of Overload for %1$s seconds, with a maximum of 4 stacks.

When activated, it releases a stream of heat in a %1$s block radius, dealing %2$s damage. Stacks of Overload are consumed to amplify the fire's power and range.
While cyberpsychosis is active: The fire triggers as if the user has 2 Overload stacks when they have less and the Overload stacks are not consumed.
This relics gains 5 experience every time you use Thermal Discharge.
This relics gains 20 experience every time explosion damage is blocked.

Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.biojoint..en: A high-tech joint implant that absorbs impact and reduces damage, providing extra protection against physical stress.

Reduces damage based on the amount taken, ranging from a maximum of %2$s% to a minimum of %1$s% reduction. The maximum reduction is achieved when the damage taken is equal to users max health or more.
While Cyberpsychosis is active: Damage reduction is always at maximum.
If multiple copies are equipped, damage reduction cannot exceed 50%.
This relics gains 3 experience every time you get hit.

Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.whims_of_.en: A cursed die that draws strength from its wielder's despair and suffering, promising salvation while demanding agony in return.
Whenever the user is hit, rolls a 20-sided die. Each number above 1 increases damage reduction by %1$s%. A 20 cancels all damage, a 1 doubles it.
This relics gains 2 experience every time you roll the dice.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.depleted_.en: Once able to regenerate threads that could alter reality, this spool has lost its power. Now silent and empty, it stands as a relic of forgotten potential.
The spool's powers can be restored by holding the required items while wearing it, reawakening its ability to regenerate reality-altering threads.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.morerelics.deple.en: The spool's regenerative abilities are restored!

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.weavers_s.en: Restored to its former power, the spool now regenerates silk that can subtly alter reality, weaving outcomes according to the weaver’s design.

Each strike against an enemy weaves silk back into your spool, building up to a maximum of 10 silk stored.
Additionally, gain silk passively every %1$s seconds when you have less than 3 silk.
Consumes 6 silk to heal for %1$s and grants absorption for a short duration, shielding you from further harm.
Consumes 3 silk to propel you in the direction you're facing with a force of %1$s and grants a speed boost for %2$s seconds afterwards.
Consumes 7 silk to unleash a blast that deals %1$s damage and severely slows enemies for %2$s seconds within a 4-block radius around you.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.whims_of_.en: This relics gains 3 experience every time you gain silk.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.moodworm..en: A symbiotic worm that manipulates its host's emotions, helping them adapt and thrive in shifting conditions.

The worm changes its mood every 10 minutes, providing different benefits:
Furious: Increases damage by %1$sX and attacks burn enemies.
Joyful: Increases speed and luck by %1$sX.
Gloomy: Reduces damage taken by %2$s% and increases resistance to knockback.

The worm can switch to a new mood.
Tranquil: Provides all the advantages of the worm's other moods.
This relic gains 20 experience each time the mood changes.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.convergin.en: A rather heavy orb made from an unknown material which permanently compresses under pressure.
Every time the user is hit the orb undergoes permanent compression, decreasing its size and dramatically increasing its density.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.morerelics.conve.en: Task: Get hit the Warden's sonic boom.
The orb exceeded critical density, collapsing in on itself to form a miniature black hole.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.wonder_of.en: The orb has collapsed in on itself, becoming a miniature black hole. It now absorbs any harm aimed at its user, redirecting it toward those who oppose them.

%1$s% of the incoming damage is also dealt to the attacker.

Reflected damage cannot exceed the user's current health.

When attacked, the attacker suffers a random negative potion effect.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.

Upon activation, the user unleashes a blast that knocks back and stuns nearby enemies.
For the next %1$s seconds, the user enters a state of nullification, gaining complete invincibility and doubling the effects of Entropy and Flow of Calamity. This ability has a cooldown of %2$s seconds.
This relic gains 5 experience each time you reflect damage.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.gravitum_.en: A glove which is made from a unique cloth-like material which anchors itself to its current position, making it very hard to move. When it collides with an object it transfers a massive amount of energy, creating a powerful impact even at low speed.
Multiplies attack damage by %1$sX but reduces attack speed by 66%.

Attacks over 20 damage (before armor) have a %1$s% chance to trigger a heavy strike, dealing 2X damage and inflicting Dazed for %2$s seconds.
Dazed enemies have a chance to miss their attacks.
This relic gains 2 experience each time the user attacks.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.vertebrax.en: A high-tech spine implant designed to boost immunity by continuously injecting poison into the body... It was quickly banned and pulled from the market due to obvious reasons.

Harmful potion effects have their duration reduced by %1$s%. These effects have a %2$s% chance to be filtered, decreasing their level or reducing duration by an additional 20% if the level is already at its minimum. Filtration also synthesizes the opposite beneficial effect for half the original duration if it exists.
While cyberpsychosis is active: Synthesized effects are more powerful and the reduction is amplified by 50%.
Completely converts Poison into Regeneration for its full duration.

Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
This relic slowly gains experience while it is worn.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.epoch_app.en: An ancient apple believed to be from the earliest generations of its kind. Its regenerative abilities allow it to recover from severe damage which is how it has survived through the ages.
The apple recovers to its full form after %1$s minutes of being eaten.
The apple ripens into greater quality after %1$s minutes of being in its full form.
This relic gains 120 experience every time it is eaten.

lang|morerelics|tooltip.relics.gravitum_.en: A boot that uses a Gravitum engine to reduce the effects of gravity. It was commonly used by astronauts for training before the severe health risks of Gravitum were discovered.
Reduces your gravity by %1$s%. Fall damage and safe fall distance are adjusted accordingly.
Jumping after crouching for one second launches you upwards with a force of %1$s. You take reduced fall damage from this jump.
This relic gains 1 experience each time the user jumps.

lang|mortal_cultivation|mortal_cultivati.en: Waste but not discouraged, mortal body hides edge, defying fate reveals the brilliant immortal path
The Foundation Establishment stage is the first step in cultivation, with some spiritual energy and the ability to perform a double jump and immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.
A cultivator who has condensed spiritual power into a Golden Core and gained finer control over qi.
A cultivator whose Golden Core has transformed into a newly formed Nascent Soul.
A cultivator whose Nascent Soul has broken through and formed a divine body.
A cultivator who refines the power of the void to temper their body and spirit.
A cultivator who has united body and soul after mastering Void Refinement.
A peak mortal cultivator standing one step away from immortal ascension.
A cultivator facing heavenly tribulation in final preparation for ascension.
A true immortal who has survived heavenly tribulation and successfully ascended.
A supreme cultivator who commands the laws of heaven and has become one with the Heavenly Dao.
The ultimate realm of one who has surpassed the Heavenly Dao and shattered its laws.

Talisman Apprentices are cultivators who have chosen to specialize in the art of talisman-making during the Foundation Establishment stage. They can perform air jumps and are immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.
An advanced cultivator who has risen from Talisman Apprentice and mastered the creation and use of talismans.
A high-level cultivator versed in the profound arts of talisman craft.
An evolution of the Sigil Master who has brought the talisman arts to their highest mortal realm.
An evolution of the Sigil Saint who has entered the immortal realm of talisman cultivation.

The Demonic Foundation Stage is the entry level of demonic cultivation where practitioners have chosen the demonic path and established the foundation for demonic cultivation, with the ability to perform a double jump and immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.
A cultivator who has formed a Demonic Core and entered the second realm of demonic cultivation.
A demonic cultivator whose Demonic Core has transformed into a Nascent Soul.
A high-level demonic cultivator whose Nascent Soul has undergone demonic transformation.
A demonic cultivator who tempers their being with the power of the infernal realm.
A cultivator who has become one with the power of the demonic path.
A demonic cultivator who has endured a great calamity and advanced toward a higher realm.
A demonic cultivator who has survived the great calamity and attained a true demon body.
A demonic cultivator who has entered the Endless Hell Realm and surpassed the power of a true demon.
A demonic cultivator who has returned to the void and reached the ultimate realm of the demonic path.

Using the Ten Thousand Soul Banner as a guide, command a hundred souls to obey. The caster activates the evil banner, instantly releasing a hundred fierce vengeful spirits that transform into a black mist ghost tide sweeping across the battlefield. The wailing souls pierce to the bone, gnawing at living flesh and tearing enemy souls. Those devoured will have their souls imprisoned in the banner, never to transcend.
