lang|rarcompat|tooltip.rarcompat.mimi_du.en: When used on a chest, it transforms it into a mimic that drops as many random relics as it originally contained before the transformation.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.umbrella.d.en: Softens the fall, providing safe landing from any height. When skillfully used, it can serve as a reliable shield, keeping enemies at bay.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.umbrella.a.en: When held in hand, reduces the player's vertical speed, negating fall damage. Pressing LMB propels the player backward and triggers a cooldown of %2$s seconds. The push can be used up to %1$s times in succession before the player touches the ground.
When used, functions as a shield, pushing targets up to %1$s blocks away.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.umbrella.l.en: +%1$s experience points for each second of falling.
+%1$s experience points for each mid-air dash performed using the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.plastic_dr.en: Speeds up the drinking process, not only quickly quenching thirst but also replenishing hunger in an extraordinary way.
Increases drinking speed by %1$s%%. Works on potions and any other items with a drinking animation.
Replenishes %1$s hunger points when consuming liquids. Works on potions and any other items with a drinking animation.
+%1$s experience points for each consumed drink.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.novelty_dr.en: Speeds up the drinking process, not only quickly quenching thirst but also replenishing hunger in an extraordinary way.
Increases drinking speed by %1$s%%. Works on potions and any other items with a drinking animation.
Replenishes %1$s hunger points when consuming liquids. Works on potions and any other items with a drinking animation.
+%1$s experience points for each consumed drink.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.snorkel.de.en: Allows for longer underwater exploration without the risk of drowning.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.snorkel.ab.en: Applies a water breathing effect for %1$s seconds upon full submersion.
Removes the fog effect in liquids.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.snorkel.le.en: +%1$s experience points for each second of the water breathing effect from the %2$s ability. If the player already has a water breathing effect, its duration is subtracted from the gained experience proportionally.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.villager_h.en: Reduces trading prices with villagers, making deals more profitable.
Increases the discount when trading with villagers by %1$s%%.
Prevents Iron Golems from attacking the player.
+%1$s experience points for each trade with villagers. The amount of experience gained increases by the discount value provided by the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.superstiti.en: Increases loot drops from defeated mobs.

Has a %1$s%% chance to apply an additional level of Looting to defeated mobs. If successful, the ability repeats, adding another Looting level. This continues until the chance fails, summing all levels.
+%1$s experience points for each additional level of Looting activated by the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.anglers_ha.en: Has a %1$s%% chance to increase the amount of catch received. If successful, the ability repeats, adding more catch. This continues until the chance fails, summing all catches.
+%1$s experience points for each additional catch generated by the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.lucky_scar.en: Increases Luck level when mining blocks.
Has a %1$s%% chance to apply an additional level of Luck to mined blocks. If successful, the ability repeats, adding another Luck level. This continues until the chance fails, summing all levels.
+%1$s experience points for each additional level of Luck activated by the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.scarf_of_i.en: When moving carefully, makes the player invisible to surroundings.

Grants the player complete invisibility. The effect is lost for %1$s seconds upon any interaction with the world. If during the absence of invisibility any mob targets the player, the effect will not restore until that mob won't lose sight of the player.
+%1$s experience points for each use of the %2$s ability to become invisible.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.flame_pend.en: Burns anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.
Has a %2$s%% chance to ignite the target attacking the player for %1$s seconds.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.shock_pend.en: Strikes with lightning anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.
Grants complete resistance to lightning damage.
Has a %2$s%% chance to strike the target attacking the player with lightning, dealing %1$s damage.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.thorn_pend.en: Poisons anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.
Has a %3$s%% chance to reflect %1$s%% damage and apply poison to the target attacking the player for %2$s seconds.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.cowboy_hat.en: Enhances the agility of the relic bearer’s mounts.
Increases the movement speed, jump height, and safe fall height of mounts by %1$s%%.
When used, this ability allows you to ride and control any mob for up to %1$s seconds. After the time expires or dismounting, it goes on a 1-minute cooldown.
+%1$s experience points with a 25% chance for each second of riding.
+%1$s experience points for each use of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.crystal_he.en: Grants the relic bearer extra strength by increasing their maximum health.
Increases the player's maximum health by %1$s points.
+%1$s experience points for each instance of health regeneration. The probability of gaining experience is inversely proportional to the ratio of current health to maximum health.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.universal_.en: Manipulates a weak magnetic field around the relic bearer, controlling the gravity of nearby items.

A toggleable ability with 3 modes: Attraction, Repulsion, and Neutrality. In the red Attraction mode, items within a radius of %1$s blocks are drawn toward the player. In the blue Repulsion mode, items are pushed away. The purple Neutrality mode disables the relic's effect.

+%1$s experience points for each item picked up using the %2$s ability. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the ratio of current item count in the stack to its maximum capacity. Does not work if the item was dropped by the relic bearer.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.cross_neck.en: Envelops the relic bearer in a protective aura, granting temporary invulnerability after each hit taken.
Increases the duration of invulnerability after taking damage by %1$s seconds.
+%1$s experience points for each instance of damage taken.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.night_visi.en: Allows the relic bearer to see more clearly in the dark.
Enhances the brightness of poorly lit areas and reduces the effectiveness of blindness and darkness by %1$s%%.

+%1$s experience points for every 5 seconds of movement in darkness. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the current light level ratio at the player's location to the maximum.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.cloud_in_a.en: Enhances the relic bearer's agility, allowing for additional jumps in the air.
Allows up to %1$s additional air jumps.
+%1$s experience points for each additional jump performed using the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.vampiric_g.en: Grants the relic bearer's attacks a vampiric effect, healing them by a portion of the damage dealt.
Heals the player for %1$s%% of the damage dealt.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the ratio of healing received to the player's maximum health.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.golden_hoo.en: Allows the relic bearer to perform more precise attacks, retaining more experience from killed mobs.
Increases experience gained from killing mobs by %1$s%%.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.onion_ring.en: Enhances the relic bearer's block mining efficiency when sufficiently satiated.
Increases block mining speed by %1$s%% per unit of the player's saturation.
When mining blocks, there is a %1$s%% chance to restore 1 hunger point and 0.5 saturation to the player.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each block mined. The chance of gaining experience is directly proportional to current saturation. Does not work on blocks with instant break.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.digging_cl.en: Strengthens the relic bearer's hands, allowing them to chop through any blocks more effectively.
Reduces the required tool level for all blocks by 1.
+%1$s experience points for each mined block. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the block's toughness. Does not work on blocks with instant destruction.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.feral_claw.en: Awakens a bloodthirsty instinct in the relic bearer, making them fight faster with each consecutive attack.

Increases the player's attack speed by %1$s%% for each consecutive attack performed within 3 seconds of the last. Otherwise, loses 1 charge per second. Attacking with an unfilled attack speed bar resets the accumulated charges.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.antidote_v.en: Enhances the relic bearer's resistance to effects.
Reduces the duration of negative effects received by %1$s%%.
Each successful attack steals %1$s seconds from all positive effects present on the target.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each effect stolen using the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.power_glov.en: Allows the relic bearer to perform empowered attacks.
Increases the player's damage dealt by %1$s%% but enters a 5-second cooldown after each attack.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.withered_b.en: Fills the relic bearer's weapon with withering energy, affecting all it touches.
Has a %1$s%% chance to apply the Wither effect to the attacked target for %2$s seconds.
Grants complete resistance to wither damage.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.snowshoes..en: Improves the relic bearer's mobility in harsh snowy conditions.
Allows walking on powder snow without sinking.
Increases movement speed on snow by %1$s%%.
+%1$s experience points for every 3 seconds of movement on snow.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.steadfast_.en: Firmly anchors the relic bearer's feet to any surface.
Increases resistance to knockback and slippery blocks by %1$s%%.
Allows slow wall sliding, negating fall damage.
+%1$s experience points for each knockback reduced by the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for every 3 seconds of sliding on blocks.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.rooted_boo.en: Grants the relic bearer the mysterious power of a sheep.
Every %1$s seconds transforms the grass block beneath the player into dirt, restoring 1 hunger and saturation point.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.warp_drive.en: Allows the relic bearer to teleport their body over short distances.
Teleports the player to a position along their line of sight within %1$s blocks, then goes on a cooldown for %2$s seconds.
Line of sight to teleport position
+%1$s experience points for every 10 blocks traversed using the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.charm_of_s.en: Allows the relic bearer to shrink their body to access previously unreachable areas.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.whoopee_cu.en: Mysteriously increases the relic bearer's flatulence, leading to entirely unpredictable outcomes.
Has a %1$s%% chance to knock back entities within a %2$s block radius, applying a 10-second nausea effect when taking damage or crouching frequently.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.kitty_slip.en: Grants the relic bearer feline traits, including soft paws and countless lives.
Scares away all Creepers and Phantoms near the player.
Increases safe falling height by %1$s blocks.
+%1$s experience points for each fall made safe by the %2$s ability.
Has a %1$s%% chance to save the player from fatal damage, leaving them with 1 health point.
+%1$s experience points for each point of damage from the last fatal attack prevented by the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.bunny_hopp.en: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to push off the ground more powerfully.
Allows high jumps by continuously holding the jump key for up to %1$s seconds.
+%1$s experience points for each high jump performed using the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.charm_of_s.en: Grants the relic bearer's legs the ability to absorb air from the ground.
While the player stands on the underwater floor, it blocks air consumption and slowly restores its supply by %1$s seconds every second.
+%1$s experience points for each touch of the underwater floor.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.panic_neck.en: Quickens the relic bearer's heartbeat, warning of impending danger.
Increases the player's movement speed by %1$s%% for each mob within a %2$s blocks radius targeting the player for attack.
+%1$s experience points for each instance of damage taken from mobs affected by the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.helium_fla.en: Temporarily allows the relic bearer to glide through air as they would water.

When performing a double jump, allows the player to float in the air for up to %1$s seconds. Movement speed in the air is proportional to the player's swimming speed with an additional bonus of %2$s%%.
+%1$s experience points for each second of air swimming using the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.pocket_pis.en: Grants the relic bearer's hands the strength of mechanisms.
Increases knockback in melee attacks by %1$s%%.
Increases maximum interaction range with the world by %1$s%%.
+%1$s experience points for each melee attack performed.
+%1$s experience points for each interaction with the world at the %2$s ability's extended range.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.obsidian_s.en: Redirects heat aimed at harming the relic bearer onto itself.
Completely absorbs damage from fire sources for up to %1$s seconds. If the player has not taken fire damage for 3 seconds, the absorption time regenerates each second.
+%1$s experience points for each second of fire damage absorption using the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.fire_gaunt.en: Grants the relic bearer’s weapon the powers of the fire element.

When attacking, releases several sparks that home in on nearby targets, igniting them for %3$s seconds and dealing %2$s%% of the performed attack's damage. The number of sparks is determined through repeated checks of a %1$s%% chance. Each successful check releases one additional spark, but the process stops as soon as the chance fails even once.
+%1$s experience points for each target hit by a spark from the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.pickaxe_he.en: Concentrates surrounding heat precisely onto the relic bearer's tools.
Smelts any mined block if possible, consuming one charge from a buffer with a capacity of %1$s units. The buffer regenerates 1 charge every %2$s seconds.
+%1$s experience points for each block smelted by the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.chorus_tot.en: Allows the relic bearer to rewind time when making rash decisions.
Each attack against the relic bearer has a %1$s%% chance per percent of missing health to teleport the attacker to a random location within a %2$s block radius.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.running_sh.en: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to move faster.
Increases the player's running speed by %1$s%%.
+%1$s experience points for each second of running.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.flippers.d.en: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to swim faster.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.flippers.a.en: Increases the player's swimming speed by %1$s%%.

lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.flippers.l.en: +%1$s experience points for each second of swimming.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.b.en: Vulnerability to Oblivion
The ability will not work under the effect of Oblivion.
Vulnerability to Silence
The ability will not work under the effect of Silence.
Flawless Ability
The ability has reached perfect parameters. Be proud of yourself!
Instantaneous Use
The ability activates immediately upon use.
Interruptible Use
The ability lasts for a certain time after use and can be interrupted by repeated use.
Cyclical Use
The ability works only with continuous use.
Toggleable Use
The ability can be toggled on/off when used.
Chargeable Use
The ability activates instantly after some time of cyclical use. The outcome may depend on the duration of use.
Stated Use
The ability has several modes that cycle with each use.
Flawless Relic
The relic has reached perfect parameters. Be proud of yourself!

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.r.en: To unlock the ability, it is necessary to connect the stars hidden beneath the fog in such a way that the resulting constellation matches the image in the background. When the constellation is correctly aligned, the ability will be automatically researched.
Cost: %1$s player experience points (%2$s relative levels) %3$s.
Hold [Shift] for fully automatic ability research.
The ability has already been researched!

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.b.en: Use the [%1$s] key outside any interface to call up the active abilities menu!

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.g.en: Earned when leveling up the relic and used to upgrade abilities.
Player experience from 'vanilla' Minecraft. Gained by killing mobs, mining ore, smelting items, etc.

Gained with each unsuccessful reroll of a relic's random attributes and increases the chance of getting better values on the next reroll. Increases the reroll cost by 5 player experience points for each percent of luck.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.r.en: To unlock, you need to level up the relic to %1$s!
Ability has no upgradeable stats and does not affect the quality of the relic!
To use, you need to conduct the research!
Ability is ready to be unlocked! Clicks remaining: %1$s
Ability is ready to be upgraded!
To unlock the experience source, you need to level up the relic to %1$s!
To unlock the experience source, you need to unlock and research the associated ability!

Relic quality is the arithmetic average of all currently unlocked abilities' quality and is measured in points from 1 to 5 with a step of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric that shows how close the item's initial random characteristics are to the best possible. To improve the overall quality of the relic, each ability needs to be considered separately.

Gained by using relic abilities as intended (more details can be found on the experience sources page). Upon reaching the maximum experience value, the relic's level and the pool of upgrade points increase by 1, allowing you to unlock previously unavailable abilities or enhance existing ones.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.a.en: Ability quality, similar to relic quality, is the arithmetic average of all the ability's current characteristics and is measured in points from 1 to 5 with a step of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric that shows how close the ability's initial random characteristics are to the best possible. To improve the ability's quality, you need to reset its random characteristics until you get a better value.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.relic.upgrade.en: Cost: %1$s upgrade points %2$s, %3$s player experience points (%4$s relative levels) %5$s.
The ability has reached its max level.
Hold [Shift] to automatically upgrade to the highest possible level.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.relic.reroll..en: Cost: %1$s player experience points (%2$s relative levels) %3$s.
Hold [Shift] to automatically reroll random stats to perfect values.
Hold [Shift] to confirm rerolling stats from perfect values to other random ones.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.relic.reset.c.en: Cost: %1$s player experience points (%2$s relative levels) %3$s.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.relic.reset.l.en: To use you need to level-up this ability at least 1 time.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.infinity_ham..en: A mysterious piece of meat that smoothly regenerates to its original size, no matter how much you carve it.
Every %1$s seconds, regenerates up to 6 edible chunks, each restoring %2$s hunger points. When consumed, the relic automatically uses the required number of chunks to replenish the player's hunger.

Allows applying potion effects to the relic by left-clicking it with a potion in the inventory. Each time the relic is consumed, it applies these effects to the player for %1$s seconds per hunger point restored. Using a water bottle clears the last applied potion effects.
Allows the relic to be used as a melee weapon, dealing %1$s damage and stunning the target for %2$s seconds per chunk. Consumes all chunks when attacking, regardless of the target's remaining health.
+%1$s experience points for each chunk consumed through the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each effect applied to the relic using the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each chunk consumed during the activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.enders_hand.d.en: +1 experience point for using the ability «End Transposition», +1 experience point for every 10 blocks from the distance to the target when using.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.enders_hand.a.en: Makes endermen neutral to the wearer.
Swaps the user and the target along the line of sight within a range of up to %1$s blocks.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.holy_locket.d.en: Grants the wearer the ability to turn enemies' healing against them.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.holy_locket.a.en: Has 2 toggleable modes: Holiness and Unholiness. In the red Holiness mode, steals %1$s%% of the healing from visible entities within a radius of %3$s blocks and transfers it to the relic's wearer. In the blue Unholiness mode, deals damage to all visible entities within the same radius equal to %2$s%% of the healing received by the relic's wearer.
Ignites undead enemies for 10 seconds and increases damage dealt to them by %1$s%%.
Killing a target grants the relic's wearer a temporary stacking immortality effect for %2$s seconds, up to a maximum of %1$s seconds.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.holy_locket.l.en: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability on an undead enemy that is not yet burning.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.magic_mirror..en: +1 experience point for each use of the «Wormhole» ability, +1 experience point for every 50 blocks to the teleportation point.
Upon use, teleports the owner to their spawn point if it is within %1$s blocks, then goes on cooldown for %2$s seconds.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.shadow_glaive.en: A masterfully forged, capricious weapon. If its temper is favorable, neither horde nor legion will withstand the onslaught of its thousand blades.

Dealing damage has a %1$s%% chance to trigger a projectile that bounces chaotically between nearby targets within a 16-block radius, up to %2$s times, dealing %3$s%% of the triggering attack's damage.
Each projectile bounce from the Mayhem ability has a %1$s%% chance to spawn an additional identical projectile.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.blazing_flask.en: +1 experience point for every 5 seconds of flight within the scope of the ability «Eternal Fire».

Using the ability on a block creates a restricted flight zone with a maximum flight speed of %2$s blocks per second and a height of %3$s blocks. The area size depends on the amount of fire within a radius of %1$s blocks around the center, but if there is no fire at all, the zone will not be created.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.elytra_booste.en: +1 experience point for every 10 seconds of burning fuel when placing it in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Acceleration».

Using any combustible fuel that would work in a furnace on the relic in the inventory replenishes its internal buffer, which has a maximum capacity of %1$s units. Activating the ability while flying with elytra gradually increases the player's flight speed up to %2$s blocks per second, consuming fuel from the internal buffer.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.midnight_robe.en: +1 experience point for every 2 units of damage when attacking while being invisible from the «Disappearing» ability.
Grants the wearer complete invisibility and increases their movement speed by %2$s%% when the total light level does not exceed %1$s.

An attack while using the 'Vanish' ability deals %1$s%% increased damage, marking a circle with a radius of %2$s blocks around the target and dispelling the wearer's invisibility. The 'Vanish' ability can only be used again after the wearer exits the circle.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.reflection_ne.en: +1 experience point for every 10 damage accumulated in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Infernal Hatred».

Accumulates damage taken by the wearer into the relic's internal buffer, with a capacity of %1$s units. Five seconds after the last damage received or if the buffer overflows, the relic explodes, scattering obsidian shards in all directions. Each shard deals %2$s damage and stuns for %3$s seconds per unit of damage stored in the relic's internal buffer.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.jellyfish_nec.en: +1 experience point for each activation of the ability «Electric Discharge».
The wearer does not sink in water.
Deals %1$s damage to targets upon collision with them.
When the «Electric Discharge» ability activates, it applies paralysis to the target for %1$s seconds.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.spore_sack.de.en: A simple burlap sack filled to the brim with deadly miasma.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.spore_sack.ab.en: When the player's health drops below 50%, releases up to %1$s homing spores around them. These spores deal damage equal to %2$s%% of the player's missing health and block healing for affected targets for 5 seconds. The ability can trigger again once the player's health rises above 50%.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.spore_sack.le.en: +%1$s experience points for each successful hit by a spore from the %2$s ability.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.ice_breaker.d.en: +1 experience point for every 3 blocks in the fall before triggering the ability «Earthquake».

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.ice_breaker.a.en: Increases fall speed, boosts knockback resistance by %1$s%%, and removes sliding on blocks.

Prolonged use of the ability while falling, up until landing, will create a shockwave with a radius of %1$s blocks, dealing up to %2$s damage and knocking back nearby targets. However, the power of the shockwave also depends on the distance the wearer has fallen.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.bastion_ring..en:
+1/5/10 experience point for each killed Zombified Piglin / Piglin / Piglin Brute.
+1 experience point for each additional trade from the ability «Respect».
Makes piglins neutral in relation to the wearer. The nearest piglin will indicate the location of a bastion nearby.
Each trade with piglins has a multiple 50% chance to yield an additional trade result, but the chance cannot trigger more than %1$s times.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.magma_walker..en: +1 experience point for every 5 units of heating from the ability «Fiery Tread».

For %1$s seconds, allows walking on the surface of lava without sinking or taking damage. After the time runs out, the boots start overheating and deal damage to the wearer proportional to the level of overheating. To cool them down, the wearer must stay away from lava blocks. The cooling time also depends on the level of overheating.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.aqua_walker.d.en: +1 experience point for every 5 units of getting wet from the ability «Moisture Resistance».

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.aqua_walker.a.en: For a certain period, allows walking on the surface of water without sinking. Once the time runs out, the boots start sinking, pulling the wearer underwater. To dry them, the wearer must stay away from water blocks. The drying time fully depends on the level of saturation.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.drowned_belt..en: +1 experience point for each level of enchantment «Riptide» on the trident when using it.
Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.
Reduces swimming speed by %1$s%% and increases the wearer's sinking speed by %1$s%%.
Increases the damage dealt by the player underwater by %1$s%%.
Allows the trident's «Riptide» enchantment ability to be used without rain or water, adding a cooldown of %1$s seconds per enchantment level.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.hunter_belt.d.en: +1 experience point for each attack made by the wearer's pet.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.hunter_belt.a.en: Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.
Increases the damage dealt by the wearer's pets by %1$s%%.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.leather_belt..en: +1 experience point for each experience gained by equipped charms.
Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.rage_glove.de.en:
+1 experience point for every 3 charges from the ability «Berserker Rage» when they are reset.
+1 experience point for each target hit by the «Spurt» ability.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.rage_glove.ab.en: Each attack made by the wearer within %3$s seconds of the last one accumulates 1 charge in the relic's internal buffer. The player's damage increases by %2$s%% per charge, but they also take %1$s%% more damage. If the player fails to attack within the given time to gain another charge, the relic's internal buffer is completely emptied, nullifying all accumulated bonuses.
Increases the player's attack speed by %3$s%% and movement speed by %2$s%%, while also granting passive health regeneration of %1$s% per missing percent of the player's health.

When activated, performs a dash in the direction of the player's gaze up to %2$s blocks, igniting, inflicting bleeding, and attacking every target in its path with the item in hand. Deals additional damage to each target equal to %1$s per charge stored in the relic's internal buffer from the «Berserker's Rage» ability and then empties it, before going on cooldown for %3$s seconds.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.ice_skates.de.en: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Skating».

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.ice_skates.ab.en: Increases movement speed on ice by %1$s%% per second of sliding. The modifier stops increasing if the sliding duration exceeds %2$s seconds.
Upon collision with targets, deals %1$s damage per second of sliding from the «Skating» ability.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.amphibian_boo.en:
+1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the «Fins» ability.
+1 experience point for every second of acceleration from the «Slipping» ability.
Increases swimming speed by %1$s%% per second of swimming. The modifier stops increasing if the swimming duration exceeds %2$s seconds.
Increases movement speed in the rain by %1$s%% per second of movement. The modifier stops increasing if the duration of movement in the rain exceeds %2$s seconds.
With a %1$s%% chance, the player may not consume an air unit while swimming or in other conditions.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.chorus_inhibi.en: +1 experience point for every 10 blocks to the teleportation point from the «Teleportation Control» ability.
Using a chorus fruit teleports the wearer to a block along the line of sight within %1$s blocks, then goes on cooldown for %2$s seconds.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.wool_mitten.d.en: +1 experience point for every 5 units of size when hit by a snowball from the ability «Mold».

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.wool_mitten.a.en: Collecting snow with an empty hand using RMB gradually forms special hardened snowballs, up to a size of %1$s units. Hitting a target with such a snowball deals %2$s damage, stuns for %3$s seconds, and freezes the target for %3$s per unit of snowball size. Holding a snowball in the inventory without the relic equipped also freezes the player.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.roller_skates.en: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Acceleration».
Increases movement speed by %1$s%% per second of movement. The modifier stops increasing if the movement duration exceeds %2$s seconds. All blocks also become slippery for the wearer.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.space_dissect.en: +1 experience point for each created portal if there is no existing one

Holding RMB creates a portal at a point along the line of sight. Releasing RMB within a distance of %1$s blocks creates a second portal in the same way, linking it to the first. When a living entity approaches a portal, it is teleported to the linked portal. Portals do not function if impassable blocks are in their way. After %2$s seconds, the portals close and disappear.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.phantom_boot..en: Condenses matter beneath the relic owner's feet, creating a path through any terrain, even where no solid ground exists.

Creates a temporary phantom bridge beneath the player's feet that any relic owner can walk on. If the player stands still on the bridge for more than %1$s seconds, they will fall through and cannot get back up until they reach solid ground. While sneaking, the player is forced to fall through the phantom bridge blocks.
+%1$s experience points with a 10%% chance each time a bridge is created using the %2$s ability.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.springy_boot..en: Grants the relic owner special elasticity, allowing them to bounce off any solid surface.
Increases the elasticity of all blocks by %1$s%% compared to slime blocks, enabling the player to bounce off them upon landing. When activated on the ground, it launches the player into the air.
+%1$s experience points for each bounce off a surface using the %2$s ability.

lang|relics|tooltip.relics.leveling_sour.en: Each time any relic in the inventory gains experience, regardless of the method, %1$s%% of that experience is also gained by this relic.

lang|relics|info.relics.researching.wron.en: Working with the relic in this inventory is not possible. Move item to the player's main inventory and try again.

lang|reliquified_lenders_cataclysm|toolt.en: An eye torn from the socket of one of the legendary End monsters. Despite the years passed, it is still alive and searching for a target for its next battle...
Pursuit

Remembers the last target attacked by the player for %2$s seconds. When the ability is activated, the player is teleported behind the remembered target and the ability goes on cooldown for %1$s seconds.
Selected Target
Teleportation Conditions Met
Pursuit
+%1$s XP for each teleportation to a target using the %2$s ability.
A homework assignment of a student from the infamous magic school where students face deadly trials, capturing lightning, clouds, or vortexes in jars...
Void Tornado

Upon killing a target, summons a void vortex %1$s blocks tall that pulls in nearby targets and goes on cooldown for %3$s seconds. After 5 seconds, the vortex explodes, dealing %2$s damage to all nearby targets. If a weaker or equal vortex is nearby, it absorbs it, growing in size and extending its duration.
Void Tornado
+%1$s XP for each void vortex created by the %2$s ability.

A robe belonging to a mage who, according to legend, lived beneath the bedrock of any known world. There he mastered a never-before-seen magic of void runes and defeated a massive End beast, whose eye still roams in search of battle.
Invulnerability
Grants complete immunity to void damage.
Call of the Void
Every %1$s seconds, summons a void rune under a random nearby target, dealing %2$s damage.
Final Cry
Upon the death of the player or their controlled creature, summons a seismic zone at the death location with a radius of %1$s blocks, triggering void runes up to %2$s times, each dealing %3$s damage.
Call of the Void
+%1$s XP for each activation of the %2$s ability.
Final Cry
+%1$s XP for each activation of the %2$s ability.
One of the filthiest tools, not wielded by warriors or mages, but by 'butchers'. Its aura liquefies the air around it, hindering both movement and mind.
The Edge
Creates an area around the player with a radius of %2$s blocks that slows all targets trying to escape it by %1$s%% at the edge. The slowdown increases the closer a target is to the boundary.
The Edge
+%1$s XP for every 10 seconds of slowdown from the %2$s ability.
A fragile yet durable device that protects the head, body, and mind all at once.
Protective Bubble

Encases the player's head in a protective bubble, completely eliminating the need for air. The bubble also blocks up to %1$s incoming attacks before exploding, scattering %2$s shards in all directions, each dealing %3$s damage. It then regenerates after %4$s seconds.
Protective Bubble
+%1$s XP for each attack blocked by the %2$s ability.

lang|reliquified_twilight_forest|tooltip.en: The hoof of a beast that guarded the heart of the underground labyrinth. Rumored to grant its wearer the speed and endurance of the frenzied minotaurs.
Stampede

While sprinting, gradually increases the player's movement speed up to %1$s%%. After 3 seconds of running, once the player reaches maximum speed, incoming damage is reduced by %2$s%%, and all nearby targets are knocked back and take %3$s damage until the player stops running.
Stampede
+%1$s experience points for each instance of damage dealt using the %2$s ability.

The most valuable part of the multi-headed fire-breathing serpent that dwells somewhere in the fiery depths of the Twilight Forest. Though its original owner is long dead, the heart still beats, dripping with searing blood.
Fiery Blood
When taking damage, has a %1$s%% chance to drop a blood droplet that, upon landing, creates a damaging area for %3$s seconds, dealing %2$s damage to all targets and igniting them for 5 seconds.
Fiery Blood
+%1$s experience points for each blood droplet created by the %2$s ability.
The crown of the Twilight Forest’s very own king - the Lich. A symbol of his power and dominance. Legend has it that the true potential of this relic can only be unlocked by uniting all ten gems...
Soulbound Gems

Allows the crown to be inlaid with %1$s special gems. Each unique gem unlocks a new ability, while additional gems of the same type increase the level of the corresponding ability. To insert a gem into the crown, right-click it while holding it in your inventory. To remove a gem, ensure your cursor is empty and right-click the crown.
Bone Pact
All skeletons become friendly towards the player.
Fortification
Every %2$s seconds, creates a shield around the player that completely blocks most directed attacks. The number of active shields cannot exceed %1$s at a time.
Will to Live
When the player's health falls below 20%, for 5 seconds, drains %1$s%% of their max health from all targets within %2$s blocks. Afterward, it enters a cooldown of %3$s seconds.
Twilight Touch
When looking at a target and pressing LMB, launches a twilight projectile moving at approximately %2$s blocks per second, dealing %1$s damage. Does not work if the target is within melee range.
Risen Servants
Every %3$s seconds, spawns a mini-zombie that fights for the player, dealing %2$s damage to targets. The total number of mini-zombies cannot exceed %1$s.
Fortification
+%1$s experience points for each shield created by the %2$s ability.
Will to Live
+%1$s experience points for every 0.5 seconds of healing done by the %2$s ability.
Twilight Touch
+%1$s experience points for each hit landed with the projectile from the %2$s ability.
Risen Servants
+%1$s experience points for each mini-zombie spawned by the %2$s ability.
A fragile and slightly disgusting-looking insect capable of spawning a swarm of fireflies that will forever dispel any darkness.
Glowkeeper

Generates a firefly larva in the internal buffer every %1$s seconds, with a maximum of %2$s at a time. When the player is in complete darkness, it consumes 1 larva and places a firefly nearby to light the way.
Glowkeeper
+%1$s experience points for each firefly placed by the %2$s ability.

A jar filled with the energy of hatred. Though this spawn of evil looks like a small bug, do not let your eyes deceive you. Its devilish song can evoke true rage in anyone who hears it, making them willing to do anything to make it stop.
Cicada's Curse
Has a %1$s%% chance on hit to inflict the Cicada's Curse on the target for %2$s seconds, forcing all nearby mobs to attack that target, ignoring their other tasks.
Cicada's Curse
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
A suspiciously large antler for an ordinary deer, which would look just as suspiciously fitting on some living creature.
On the Horns!
When used on a creature whose hitbox volume does not exceed %1$s blocks, places it on the player's antlers and prevents it from dealing damage to the player.
On the Horns!
+%1$s experience points for every 3 seconds spent with a creature on the antlers from the %2$s ability.
A cloak woven from giant serpent scales not only takes on the shape of its previous owner but also inherits some of her abilities.
Grip
Allows the player to smoothly climb walls for %1$s seconds. After the duration ends, the player will slowly slide down.
Elusive Stare
When taking damage, has a %1$s%% chance to make the attacker miss if the player maintains eye contact with them.
Grip
+%1$s experience points for each second of climbing from the %2$s ability.
Elusive Stare
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
A feather from the tail of a mysterious bird that could transform into other creatures.
Execution
When attacking a target whose current health does not exceed the player's maximum health, there is a %1$s%% chance to instantly execute it, transforming it into a small bird.
Execution
+%1$s experience points for each successful activation of the %2$s ability.
An ornament closely tied to torment. Its sharp thorns dig into the wearer's head, bringing both unbearable pain and paralyzing power.
Acupuncture
Upon touching a target, deals %3$s damage and has a %1$s%% chance to paralyze them for %2$s seconds.
Oak Skin
Grants the player full resistance to any 'thorn' damage.
Acupuncture
+%1$s experience points for each paralysis triggered by the %2$s ability.
A remarkably flexible yet durable material forms the basis of this cape, providing not only protection for its wearer but also retaliation when their safety is threatened.
Invulnerability

When taking damage that could potentially be mitigated by armor (even if none is equipped), reduces it by %1$s points. If the damage is not fully blocked, there is a %2$s%% chance to launch a steel orb toward the attacker, dealing %3$s damage to all in its path and stunning them for %4$s seconds.
Invulnerability
+%1$s experience points for each steel orb released by the %2$s ability.
A seemingly ordinary backpack, yet for some unknown reason, charms inside it behave differently...
Charm Storage

Allows storing up to %1$s life or inventory charms inside the backpack. When a charm activates, it prevents complete destruction and instead goes on cooldown for %2$s minutes per its level. To store a charm, right-click on the backpack in the inventory with it. To extract a charm, the cursor must be empty.
Charm Storage
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
A nose crudely taken from a goblin. No one suspected that goblins could shed skin like lizards...
Goblin Sense

When activated, worsens vision but enhances smell, allowing the detection of valuable ores within a %1$s block radius. Also allows storing up to %2$s ore blocks inside the nose, so the sense only recognizes them. To store ore, right-click the nose in the inventory with it. To extract ore, the cursor must be empty.
Goblin Sense
+%1$s experience points for each ore mined under the effect of the %2$s ability.
A piece of gear once worn by fairy-tale giants who dwell in cloud-top huts. It's said the only way to reach them is with magic beans whose stalk pierces the skies...
Giant's Grip
Increases the size and stats of the held item by %1$s%%.
Giant's Grip
+%1$s XP for each block broken or entity hit made with an item enhanced by %2$s.
A stylish and vibrant cloak, woven from the wool of a mythical rainbow sheep...
Spectrum Magic

Stores up to %1$s slots of wool with up to %2$s units each. Every wool color grants a specific effect, applied for %3$s seconds if not already active, consuming one unit of wool. To insert wool, right-click the cloak in inventory with wool; to extract, make sure the cursor holds no item.
Color Focus
Increases the effect level based on the number of identical-colored wool slots, up to a maximum level of %1$s.
Spectrum Magic
+%1$s XP for each level of effect granted by the %2$s ability.
Frostbite
Applies a stacking frostbite effect for %1$s seconds on attack. Once the effect exceeds 7 seconds, the target takes 1 damage through armor every 2 seconds until the effect ends.
Frostbite
+%1$s XP for each frostbite effect applied by %2$s.
An endless syrup bottle that occasionally conjures up fresh waffles.
Sugar Rush
Eating a waffle increases health regeneration by %2$s%% for %3$s seconds; the effect stacks. There's a %1$s%% chance the waffle won't be consumed.
Sugar Rush
+%1$s XP for each waffle eaten.
A strange thing – stare at it long enough and it... starts vanishing? Hard to imagine why the emperor needed such a cloak...
Imperial Attire
Hides the appearance of equipped armor.
Camouflage
Grants full invisibility after remaining completely still or sneaking without interruption for at least %1$s seconds.
Camouflage
+%1$s XP for each activation of the %2$s ability.

...deep within the prison chambers of the §kDark§r Tower, inmate number 115 was forcibly infected with an unknown §kparasite§r. The §klarva§r entwined with his body, feeding on his §kmind§r and flesh until only a twisted mass of reddish §krot§r remained. The warped minds of the wardens immediately forced the §kunfortunate soul§r from the neighboring cell to taste the result. He resisted, but once a piece touched his tongue...
Invasion

Has a %1$s%% chance to infect the attacked target with a parasite, which, if the target is not attacked again within 5 seconds, delivers %2$s rapid strikes dealing %3$s damage each. If the target is killed by the parasite's attack, a random amount of §kExperiment 115§r will drop, up to %4$s units.
Invasion
+%1$s XP for each parasite infection caused by the %2$s ability.

...suddenly he began to tremble, his body arching as if §ksomething§r inside tried to break free. His eyes turned white, and with a mad roar he attacked a warden, then another, and another... until no one remained in his path. He awoke deep within the §kwilderness§r of the Twilight Forest - wounded, barefoot, covered in blood. Who knows if it was his last meal to blame, or if he is now the victim of a new experiment - §k116§r.
Invasion

Has a %1$s%% chance to infect the attacked target with a parasite, which, if the target is not attacked again within 5 seconds, delivers %2$s rapid strikes dealing %3$s damage each. If the target is killed by the parasite's attack, a random amount of §kExperiment 115§r will drop, up to %4$s units.
Rage Consumption

Consuming §kExperiment 115§r restores %1$s%% rage charge, which is consumed at a rate of 10%% per second. Rage increases the player's movement speed, attack speed, and damage. At 100%% rage, the bonus reaches %2$s%%.
Invasion
+%1$s XP for each parasite infection caused by the %2$s ability.
Rage Consumption
+%1$s XP for each consumed §kExperiment 115§r.
Mirror Leech
Any attack on the player has a %1$s%% chance to be reflected back to the attacker, healing the player for the amount of damage dealt.
Mirror Leech
+%1$s XP for each full unit of damage reflected using the %2$s ability.
Vendetta
Attacking a target that damaged the player in the last %1$s seconds increases damage by %2$s%%.
Vendetta
+%1$s XP for each attack with increased damage from the %2$s ability.
Heat Concentration
Increases damage dealt by %1$s%% for every 0.1 unit of biome temperature where the player is located.
Heat Concentration
+%1$s XP for each attack with bonus damage from the %2$s ability.
Ethereal Transformation
Any projectile aimed at the player passes through without causing harm. After %1$s deflections, the ability goes on cooldown for %2$s seconds.
Ethereal Transformation
+%1$s XP for each projectile deflected using the %2$s ability.
Frenzy

Attacking different targets consecutively increases damage by %1$s%% per hit. Damaging a previously attacked target or not attacking for more than 5 seconds resets the bonus. Killing a target while the effect is active resets the target list without losing the accumulated bonus.
Frenzy
+%1$s XP for each bonus gained from the %2$s ability.
Twilight Sovereign
Grants full immortality within the boundaries of the Twilight Forest.

lang|tensura|tensura.message.slime.maxsi.en: Your slime has reached its Max Size!

lang|tensura|tensura.message.slime_staff.en: Every slime in 30-block radius is set to Follow.
Every slime in 30-block radius is set to Stay.

lang|tensura|tensura.naming.had_owner.en: The target is faithful with its current owner.

lang|tensura|tensura.naming.insane.en: The target is not sane enough.

lang|tensura|tensura.naming.name_success.en: You have been given the name %s by %s.
You have been given the name %s.

lang|tensura|tensura.naming.nameable_sta.en: Your nameable status has been set to %s.

lang|tensura|tensura.naming.not_submit.en: The target does not want to submit.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.ancient_giant..en: Ancient form of Giants with even more incredible physical capabilities and abilities.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.arch_daemon.de.en: The peak evolutionary stage that can be reached by daemons in the Daemon Realm. Only the most powerful of greater daemons can ascend to this height.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.beast_lord.des.en: Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.beastfolk.desc.en: A race that can freely change between their true animal form and a more a human form. They possess immense physical prowess and regenerative capabilities that let them fight without rest.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.daemon_lord.de.en: One of the most powerful evolutionary stages of daemons, achieved only by the most powerful arch daemons.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.death_oni.desc.en: Wicked Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.demon_slime.de.en: The ultimate stage of evolution of Slimes. They evolve to this stage by awakening as a True Demon Lord during the Harvest Festival.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.devil_lord.des.en: The final stage of evolution for daemons. One emerges when a daemon meets all three requirements of a name, material body, and divinity.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_beast.d.en: Beastfolk that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_bird.de.en: Harpy that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_boar.de.en: Orc that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_dragon..en: Dragonewt that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_dwarf.d.en: Dwarf that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_elf.des.en: Elf that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_fighter.en: Wicked Oni that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_fish.de.en: Merfolk that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_giant.d.en: A godly race born from the earth itself, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_human.d.en: Human that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_oni.des.en: Oni that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_skeleto.en: Wight that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_vampire.en: Vampire that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.dragonewt.desc.en: The evolved form of Lizardmen and descendants of dragons. They have an average lifespan of about two hundred years.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.dwarf.descript.en: A sprite race descended from earth elementals. They possess an immense will and make for fierce albeit rather short soldiers.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.dwarf_saint.de.en: Dwarf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.elf.descriptio.en: A sprite race descended from wind elementals. They possess a fierce talent for elemental magic and are more in tune with nature than most.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.elf_saint.desc.en: Elf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_dw.en: Dwarf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_el.en: Elf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_ho.en: Hobgoblin that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_hu.en: Human that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_me.en: Merfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_og.en: Ogre that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.ghoul.descript.en: A vampiric thrall brought about by Blood Raise, highly weakened by sunlight.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.giant.descript.en: A race of powerful Majin most notable for their incredible physical capabilities and Magic Resistance.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.goblin.descrip.en: A race of Sprite Demi-Humans. They seem to be descended from the offspring of Dwarves and Oni.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.god_slime.desc.en: The divine stage of evolution of Slimes.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.greater_daemon.en: The daemon race that lesser daemons evolve to when they develop their ego and accumulate enough power.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.harpy.descript.en: A race of winged Majin with capability to cancel out flight spell and are often referred to as the rulers of the skies.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.harpy_queen.de.en: A Queen Species of Harpy with the ability to reproduce through Parthenogenesis or Virgin Birth.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.high_orc.descr.en: The evolved form of Orcs. They are smarter than Orcs while preserving the Orc race's special characteristics, with appearance virtually identical to regular Orcs.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.hobgoblin.desc.en: The evolved form of male Goblins that is ranked D on average.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.hobgoblin_sain.en: Hobgoblin that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.human.descript.en: A weak but populous race that relies more on technology and numbers than brute force. Their low magicule count makes skills and magic users a rarity among them, instead favouring battlewill.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.human_saint.de.en: Human that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.kijin.descript.en: A race of Sprite Demi-Humans descended from Fire Elementals. They have an average lifespan of over a thousand years

lang|tensura|tensura.race.lesser_daemon..en: The lowest level of the daemon race. They spontaneously come into existence within the Daemon Realm where they slowly accumulate experience from fighting and being summoned before eventually evolving into greater daemons.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.lizardman.desc.en: A race of scaled people descended from dragons. Their webbed feet give them an advantage in wet terrain.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.merfolk.descri.en: A sprite race descended from water elementals. Their fish-like bodies give them an insurmountable advantage in water.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.merfolk_saint..en: Merfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.metal_slime.de.en: A slime that has taken in large quantities of Magic Ore. The dissolved ore inside of it provides a strong resistance towards most forms of damage.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.mystic_oni.des.en: The result of Kijin fully returning to their roots as Elementals, making them Spiritual Lifeforms.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.ogre.descripti.en: A sprite race descended from fire elementals. They possess immense physical capabilities and a strong Japanese lineage.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.orc.descriptio.en: A race of beastfolk who lost the ability to shift between man and beast, resulting in a permanent mix of the two. Their physical strength is greater than average but pails in comparison to their original strength as beastfolk.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.orc_disaster.d.en: The evolution of an Orc Lord that is a Demon Lord Seed.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.orc_lord.descr.en: A very rare and powerful member of the Orc race with high intelligence who appears roughly every few centuries.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.slime.descript.en: A Spectral race of monster that lacks intelligence and ambition. They’re usually passive but are incredibly ruthless once provoked.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_beast.d.en: Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_bird.de.en: Harpy that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_boar.de.en: Orc that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_oni.des.en: Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_skeleto.en: Wight that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.true_dragonewt.en: The evolution of Dragonewts and complete Spiritual Lifeforms. They are the second-highest evolutionary stage of Dragonewt known to exist.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.vampire.descri.en: A race of Majin with nearly eternal life. Although they can reproduce, they normally abstain. Hosting overwhelming magical energy and vitality, their flesh never decays.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.vampire_lord.d.en: A vampire among the loftiest levels of power, comparable to a Demon Lord.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.vampire_overco.en: Vampires that have evolved to overcome their weakness against the sun.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.wicked_oni.des.en: A variant of Oni, possessing an essence that leans closer towards that of a Daemon rather than that of a pure Elemental.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.wight.descript.en: A Demi-Spiritual skeletal Undead Monster, highly weakened by sunlight.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.wight_king.des.en: A type of Undead Monster and an evolution of Wights. They possess fearsome power comparable to that of Demon Lord Seeds.

lang|tensura|tensura.reincarnation.rando.en: A race randomly selected from a configurable list of options, adding an element of unpredictability to the experience. Are you willing to take the risk?

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.abnormal_cond.en: Completely negate all abnormal conditions and their effects.
Resist the effects of weaker abnormal conditions or reduce the severity of stronger ones.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.absolute_seve.en: Wield the power to cut through any who stand in your path, whether by coating your strikes or launching slashing projectiles that sever all in their path.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.absorb_and_di.en: Dissolve specific items to instantly consume them.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.acid_rain.des.en: Summon an acidic cloud which will corrode any afflicted entities.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.acid_shell.de.en: Shoots a ball of corrosive acid toward targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.acquire_faile.en: Failed to acquire %s due to the lack of Magicule.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.aerial_blade..en: Pull in any nearby entities before dealing massive damage by unleashing the power of your spirit.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.agility.descr.en: Greatly enhance the caster's movement speed.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.air_flight.de.en: Use your aura to propel you forward, and hover in air.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.airflow_shut..en: Drain out all the air surrounding the targets and suffocate them.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.all_seeing_ey.en: Go into a 3rd person mode, with your increased POV you gain movement and action buffs as well as an upgrade to Presence Sense.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.analyst.descr.en: Enhance cognitive processing, analyze targets and phenomena, accelerate magic casting and deepen understanding of the laws of the world to optimize all actions.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.analytical_ap.en: Assess the strength of your opponents to gain insight into their overall strength.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.anti_magic_ar.en: Creates a zone around the user that limits all Aspectual and Summoning Magics.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.anti_shock_ar.en: Creates a zone around the user that limits all physical damage taken.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.anti_skill.de.en: Become immune to damage from Magic, Skills and Battlewill, destroy barriers and block skill usage of other entities.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.antidote.desc.en: Recover a living being from nausea, poison and weakness.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.aura_shield.d.en: Create a shield of condensed aura to block attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.aura_slash.de.en: Condense your aura along your blade and release ranged slash.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.aura_sword.de.en: Coat your weapon in aura enhancing its blows.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.barrier.descr.en: Coat the caster with a Physical Barrier with the strength based on Health.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.battlewill.de.en: Channel your will, converting magicules into aura.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.beast_transfo.en: Transform into a beast to restore your vitality and boost your physical body. The transformation will grant great physical prowess but leave a toll on your body.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.berserk.descr.en: Massively empower your body and infuse it with a flame aura. Allows you to go into a risky but overwhelmingly powerful berserker mode.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.berserker.des.en: Feed on your enemies' defeat. Gain EP from kills, destroy equipment faster, and boost your physical stats based on your power level.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.bewilder.desc.en: Manipulate friends and foes, compelling them to act according to your will.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.black_flame.d.en: Command the tempest infused flames to spew out black flames at your enemies or even shoot deadly fireballs and hell flares.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.black_lightni.en: Shoot black lightning at varying strength, or summon a massive storm which attacks any non-allied mobs. A short range plasma blast can also be used to melt even the strongest of foes.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.blizzard.desc.en: Creates a powerful storm of ice to slow your enemies and turn the tides of battle.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.blood_mist.de.en: Spill your own blood to summon a mist which steals the vitality of your enemies and can be blown up to harm any nearby entities or shoot a powerful blood beam.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.body_armor.de.en: Protect yourself from harm by summoning armorsaurus scales around your body.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.body_double.d.en: Use a tenth of your magical power to summon an identical clone which takes increased damage but will fight for you until the end. The user can exchange places with the clone but risk taking increased damage.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.burden.descri.en: Shoot energy projectiles that increase the target's gravity.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.chain_explosi.en: Summon a sequence of explosion that detonates in a chain around targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.chant_annulme.en: Become able to cast mastered magic instantly, in water or even under the effects of silence.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.charm.descrip.en: Use your inherent power to turn your opponents neutral or to temporarily dominate weak opponents.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.chef.descript.en: Purify and renew. Remove all negative effects and restore vitality to those under your care.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.chosen_one.de.en: Radiate authority and charisma to force fear into the hearts of your enemies and to make them follow you instead, while empowering yourself and your allies.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.coercion.desc.en: Shoot a blast of roar in front of you scaring any afflicted entities.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.cold_resistan.en: Ignore weak cold damage or resist the damage of powerful attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.commander.des.en: Lead the charge with your allies. Empower yourself and your allies to give yourself an overwhelming advantage.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.confusion.des.en: Apply vision confusion to surrounding targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.cook.descript.en: Bend reality to ensure your enemies meet their demise by ignoring their dodge and barriers.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.corrosion.des.en: Empower your attacks with the deadly effect of Corrosion, toggleable when mastered.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.corrosion_res.en: Ignore weak corrosive effects or reduce the damage from stronger corrosive attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.create_greate.en: Call forth armed undead from the ground to aid the caster.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.create_lesser.en: Call forth weak undead from the ground to aid the caster.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.creator.descr.en: Create any Unique Skill and use it for a limited amount of time.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.curse.descrip.en: Release Miasmic Mist to curse targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.curse_bind.de.en: Call forth spirits of the death to bind and corrode targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.danger_sense..en: Receive a mental warning when entities with hostile intent enter your proximity.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dark_cube.des.en: Create a cube of darkness that slows movement and deals constant damage.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dark_eight_pa.en: Launch up to eight devastating aura blasts at foes.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.darkness.desc.en: Call on your spirit to reduce the enemy's vision in a wide area.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.darkness_atta.en: Ignore weaker darkness damage or reduce the damage of stronger attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.darkness_cann.en: Shoot a long beam which deals massive damage, destroys armor and debilitates enemies.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.darkness_tran.en: Channel your inner darkness to burn and blind nearby opponents.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.death_march_d.en: Gather your aura into a ring of devastating aura spheres that come crashing down.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.degenerate.de.en: Craft, decraft, customize items and absorb strength from weakened enemies.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.demon_dominat.en: Dominate over any targets up to the Calamity level.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.demon_lord_ha.en: Unleash your Demonic aura causing those around you to quake in fear.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.demon_marione.en: Dominate over any targets even at the Disaster level.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.diamond_path..en: Harden your aura around you to block incoming attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dimension_cut.en: Tear space to send forward a blade of dimension rift.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.divine_berser.en: Empower your body by a massive amount but beware the aftereffects.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.divine_ki_rel.en: Use your Divine Ki to amplify your battlewill to deal more damage and destroy weaker equipment.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.doppelganger..en: Use percentages of the user's magical power to create identical clones around them.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dragon_ear.de.en: Use your sensitive hearing to precisely pin the location of any nearby mobs which make sound.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dragon_eye.de.en: Use your powerful sight to access the power of any entities and see in the far distance.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dragon_mode.d.en: Once a day, draw out your monstrous potential to double your EP and to boost your physical prowess. Doing this will leave a temporary toll on your body.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.dragon_skin.d.en: Transform your skin into scales which become tougher as you gain more EP.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.drain.descrip.en: Steal the vitality of your opponent and temporarily transform this skill into one of theirs to potentially turn the tables.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.drainage.desc.en: Drain the water around the caster.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth.descrip.en: Place down blocks which mimic those from the surrounding environment.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_attack_.en: Ignore weak earth-based damage or resist the damage from powerful attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_dominat.en: Boosts the power of  Earth abilities by a large amount.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_jail.de.en: Restrict and weaken a single target, applying debuffs to allow you to finish them off.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_lock.de.en: Solidify the earth where the caster desires.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_manipul.en: Boosts the power of Earth abilities by a decent amount.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_spikes..en: Raises earth spikes from the ground to pierce through your enemies.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_storm.d.en: Summons a viscous sandstorm and falling rocks around you.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_transfo.en: Channel the powers of the earth to deal increased damage and increase local gravity around you.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earth_wall.de.en: Call forth giant earth walls from the ground.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.earthshatter_.en: Stomp your foot down upheaving the land around you.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.eight_petals_.en: Dash and attack the target's eyes, throat, heart, kidneys, lungs, and groin with eight consecutive and near instant slashes.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.electricity_r.en: Ignore weak electrical damage or resist the damage from stronger attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.electro_blast.en: Fire a beam attack that pierces through enemies and deals devastating damage while paralyzing your enemies.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.elephant_stam.en: Throw a ring of aura spheres around you.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.engorger.desc.en: Increase your size and boost your physical stats.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.envy.descript.en: Absorb strength from enemies, buff yourself and debilitate your enemies.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.escape.descri.en: Connect two points in space to create a escape route.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.escape.too_fa.en: The escape magic circle is too far away.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.explosion.des.en: Summon a single beam of light, that detonates at the target, creating a devastating blast of pure magical power.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.eye_of_truth..en: By obtaining the mythical Hero Egg, the veil of deception is torn apart. No illusion or concealment can deceive your sight, and your vision becomes perfect.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.falsifier.des.en: See through falsehoods and invisibility, conceal your presence from prying eyes and create illusions.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.farsight.desc.en: Focus your eyes and become able to see things far away.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fighter.descr.en: Achieve mastery through discipline. Learn combat and magic abilities instantly, gain more mastery points, and hit much harder.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fire.descript.en: Use your spirit to start a small fire.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fire_breath.d.en: Breathe flames and incinerate your enemies.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fire_storm.de.en: Call forth fiery surges of flame to incinerate targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fire_wall.des.en: Create a wall of fire to keep targets away.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.five_petals_t.en: Dash and pierce the opponent in five of ten vital points and uses the other five as feints.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_attack_.en: Ignore weaker flame damage or resist the damage from more powerful flames.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_breath..en: Spew fire to burn away enemies and set fire to the land.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_dominat.en: Boosts the power of fire abilities by a large amount.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_manipul.en: Boosts the power of fire abilities by a decent amount.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_transfo.en: Channel the powers of fire to burn all nearby foes.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_wall.de.en: Create a wall of illusional fire to keep targets away.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flare_circle..en: Opens a Gate to Hell from which wicked flames erupt to turn your enemies to ash.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flight.descri.en: Propel the caster forward in the air.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.float.descrip.en: Decrease the caster's gravity to float.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.formhide.desc.en: Match your aura to the surroundings, which makes you imperceptible.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.full_recovery.en: Recover a living being's health and food points to the maximum as well as Absorption.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fusionist.des.en: Turn the world into a weapon, absorb the environment to create powerful mines and grenades.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gate.descript.en: Tear space asunder connecting two points in space.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.giantificatio.en: Grow beyond your normal size to gain increased strength and reach.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gluttony.desc.en: Absorb all in your path. None can win. Receive and provide skills, gain access to a spatial storage and mimic entities.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.godly_craftsm.en: Utilize your years of experience to create masterpieces with ease and engrave your weapons for terrifying efficiency.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.godwolf_sense.en: Improve your senses to be able to see in the dark or even spot invisible entities nearby.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gourmand.desc.en: Feast on the energy of your opponents. Steal magicule with your attacks and become more powerful when killing others.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Yuuki
Me
You are the one everyone has been talking about lately, right? I heard you have solved quite a few problems.
I just happened to pass by. It was not a big deal.
Too modest. If that many people mention you, it already says plenty about your ability.
So why are you looking for me?
Simple. Would you like to join our Adventurers Guild?
Adventurers Guild?
More precisely, the Free Guild. We do not force members to swear loyalty to any country, and we do not restrict your actions. You can take commissions, gather information, and use guild resources.
That does sound convenient. But why invite me?
Because you are special. Someone like you acting alone would be a waste.
Are you trying to recruit me?
You could put it that way. I prefer to call it cooperation.
What if I refuse?
That is fine too. The Free Guild respects freedom. But I believe you will eventually need a place where you can exchange information and commissions.
You sound very confident.
It is not confidence. It is experience. In this world, strength alone can solve many things, but not everything.
Then if I join, what do I need to do?
Register your identity first. After that, you can freely choose commissions. Regular jobs, escorts, investigations, monster subjugation, all of them are available.
No hidden conditions?
At least not right now.
That "right now" sounds suspicious.
Haha, you caught that? Do not worry. I will not let you lose out.
Then I will first see what your guild can offer me.
Of course. Welcome to the Free Guild. I hope we get along well.
Yuuki: Thank you very much for becoming a member of our guild.
Do you need something?
