The workshop needs Magic Ore Shards to test a new processing recipe. Search the mines for magic ore and bring back the shards in the best condition you can.
The miner needs magicule-bearing ore fragments. They do not need many, but they must be real magic ore. Bring back enough Magic Ore Shards for the agreed reward.
Deep in the mines, faintly glowing magic ore sometimes appears. Carefully mine it and bring back usable Magic Ore Shards before the material is wasted.
Recent orders have buried the leatherworker, and the Monster Leather (D) stock is nearly gone. Gather a usable batch and return it to the task giver before the time limit ends.
The leatherworker is rushing basic travel gear, and belts and liners all need Monster Leather (D). Gather proper materials and bring them back.
More people are ordering clothes and leather fittings, and the Monster Leather (C) stock will not last. Bring back a usable batch to keep the orders moving.
The leatherworker needs sturdy Monster Leather (C) for armguard linings and coat straps. Gather the materials and return them to the task giver.
The job must be delivered on time, and without enough Monster Leather (B), the leatherworker's reputation is at risk. Bring back a batch of good leather.
Tailoring armor is not only about thread. If the leather is poor, the finished gear will not pass. Gather a proper batch of Monster Leather (B).
This is not cheap leather from a market stall. The leatherworker needs Monster Leather (A) that can truly hold up. Bring the materials back.
Advanced adventurer gear needs more reliable Monster Leather (A), and common stock will not do. Gather a batch of quality materials for the leatherworker.
Giant Ant carapace is sturdy enough to test a full smithing set. Make the full set and bring it back so I can check the finish.
Serpent scales are light and durable, perfect for a set that balances movement and defense. Make the full set and hand it over.
Knight Spider carapace is tough enough for a full finished set. Make the set and bring it back so I can check the joints.
Armorsaurus scales make reliable armor. Make the full set and bring it back so I can see what the workshop can do.
Low Magisteel gear is a solid test of basic smithing skill. Make the full set and bring it back for inspection.
This dwarf task is missing its description.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: I need %s Hipokute Flowers for medicine work. Bring them back within %s and I will reward you.
The Hipokute Flowers on my herb shelf are almost gone. Bring me %s within %s.
If you have time, plant or gather some Hipokute Flowers for me. I need %s within %s.
How is the Hipokute Flower request going? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good, you have all %s Hipokute Flowers. Hand them over and I will settle the reward.
This vein can yield Magic Ore Shards, and I need the material. Bring me %s within %s.
Magic ore holds magicules, and the workshop is waiting to start. Mine %s Magic Ore Shards within %s.
I need Magic Ore Shards to test a new processing recipe. Bring me %s within %s, as intact as you can.
I do not need ordinary gravel. It has to be real Magic Ore Shards. Bring me %s within %s.
Deep mines sometimes hold faintly glowing magic ore. Carefully mine %s Magic Ore Shards and bring them back within %s.
How are the Magic Ore Shards coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
That is enough. Hand over the %s Magic Ore Shards, and this Pure Magisteel Pickaxe should serve you well.
Recent orders are crushing me, and the leather stock is almost gone. If you have time, bring me %s Monster Leather (D) within %s.
Hey, I am short on leather. If you want payment, bring me %s Monster Leather (D), and do not try to pass off torn scraps. Time limit: %s.
How is the Monster Leather (D) coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
That is enough. Hand over the %s Monster Leather (D), and I will settle the reward.
More people are ordering clothes and leather fittings, but my stock will not last. Bring me %s Monster Leather (C) within %s.
I am making travel gear for adventurers, and everything from armguard linings to coat straps needs sturdy leather. Bring me %s Monster Leather (C) within %s.
How is the Monster Leather (C) coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good, %s Monster Leather (C) is enough to get started. Hand it over.
This job has to be delivered on time. Without enough good leather, my signboard is at risk. Bring me %s Monster Leather (B) within %s.
Good armor is not made with thread alone. Poor leather makes poor gear. Gather %s Monster Leather (B) within %s.
How is the Monster Leather (B) coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good. The %s Monster Leather (B) is usable quality. Hand it over.
This is not cheap market leather. I need leather that can really do the job. Bring me %s Monster Leather (A) within %s.
Advanced adventurer gear cannot be patched together with poor materials. Bring me %s Monster Leather (A), and I will pay you properly. Time limit: %s.
How is the Monster Leather (A) coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Well done. %s Monster Leather (A) is enough to finish this batch. Hand it over.
I want a full Giant Ant Carapace set, and the workmanship had better be clean. Bring the set back within %s and I will settle up.
Serpent Scalemail is a good fit for this job. Make the full set and bring it back within %s, no missing pieces.
Knight Spider carapace is not easy to work with, so I want the full set. Bring the armor back within %s and make it count.
The workshop wants an Armorsaurus Scalemail set. Bring the full set back within %s, and do not drag it out.
Low Magisteel is simple enough, but the set has to be neat. Bring the full armor set back within %s.
How is the armor set coming along? You have %s/%s pieces. Time left: %s.
Good. All %s armor pieces are ready. Hand them over and I will settle the reward.
Hey! How about I give you a map to the Adventurer Guild? I think you would be a great fit there!
Hmph. I do not hand work to people who are unwelcome here.
Clean up your name before you come asking me for a request.
The guild does not trust just anyone, especially someone with your reputation.
I have heard about you. I have nothing to entrust to you for now.
Until you prove yourself, do not expect me to give you work.
Want a request? Make the dwarves willing to trust you again first.
You do not have a good name here. I have no reason to hire you.
You lack even basic credit, and you still want work from me?
Go clean up the trouble you caused, then come back.
I am not short on adventurers. I am short on people worth trusting.
Do not blame me for being blunt. With a reputation like yours, I cannot use you.
When your reputation is no longer negative, we can talk requests again.
Your name has not been traveling well lately, so I will not risk workshop business on you.
Dwarves trade on trust, and right now that is exactly what you lack.
Stay away from my request board until people here trust you again.
I will not put my work at risk for your bad name. No requests today.
Get the dwarf quarter willing to nod at you first, then knock on my door.
If you truly want work, earn back the trust you lost first.
How is the fresh meat collection going? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
That is enough. Hand over the %s cuts. I will pay you and throw in the cooked stock I prepared.
How are the materials coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good. Hand over the %s materials. These will keep today's work moving.
Still short on Blade Tiger tails? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good work. %s Blade Tiger tails will do nicely. Hand them over and the gold is yours.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: The butcher wants raw Blade Tiger meat for a new curing method. If the cuts are fresh enough, they can become travel rations fit for adventurers. Bring back a usable batch.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Blade Tiger meat has firm fibers and makes excellent dried rations. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Armorsaurus meat comes in heavy cuts and works well for soups and stews. The butcher wants to stock up today, so bring back a fresh batch.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Armorsaurus meat makes the most filling broth around. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Cattledeer beef always sells well, and the butcher wants the next batch ready before evening. Bring back a supply of decent cuts.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Demand for Cattledeer beef is high and my stock is nearly gone. Bring me %s cuts within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Giant Bat meat gains a distinct flavor once cured, and even taverns place orders for it now and then. The butcher is short on that ingredient, so refill the supply.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: A customer asked for Giant Bat meat and I am completely out. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Knight Spider legs take effort to prepare, but the cooked result is better than most expect. The butcher wants a batch ready to test demand.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Knight Spider legs look nasty, but some people swear by them once stewed. Bring me %s legs within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Giant Ant legs yield more usable meat than they seem, and skewered cuts sell well enough. The butcher needs ingredients in a hurry.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: The kitchen wants to test a new roast today, and it needs proper ingredients first. Bring me %s Giant Ant legs within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Serpent meat has a strong smell and must be processed while fresh. The butcher wants to turn it into a spice cure, so bring back enough to work with.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Serpent meat spoils in flavor if it sits too long. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s while it is still fresh.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Spear Toro meat is tender and perfect for salted slices that keep well. The butcher is missing this main ingredient, so fill the order.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Spear Toro meat is delicate, and a proper cure turns it into premium stock. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Dried Spear Toro fins make a fine stock for soups, and both taverns and workshops have use for them. The butcher is short on material, so gather a batch.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: I want to simmer a few proper pots of fish broth, but I am out of Spear Toro fins. Bring me %s within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Giant Ant carapace is hard, but intact pieces can be turned into knife handles and kitchen guards. The butcher wants material that can go straight to work.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Do not underestimate carapace. Treated properly, it has its uses in a kitchen. Bring me %s intact Giant Ant carapaces within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Knight Spider carapace has the toughness needed for small workshop tools once polished down. The butcher wants to restock supplies.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Knight Spider carapace is both tough and resilient, perfect for refitting a few tools. Bring me %s within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Armorsaurus scales are heat-resistant and sturdy, useful for replacing worn shields beside the stove. Gather a batch that is still fit to use.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: The guards by the stove are wearing out, and Armorsaurus scales are just right to replace them. Bring me %s within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Armorsaurus shell is thick and dependable, and once flattened it makes a fine butchering board. The butcher wants to replace old equipment.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Armorsaurus shell is thick enough to make a fine work board once shaped. Bring me %s within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Serpent scales have a dense surface that suits finer kitchen fittings for trimming meat and fish. The butcher is short on this useful material.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Serpent scales are just right for small fittings and fine work. Bring me %s within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Centipede stingers need careful handling, but once processed they can aid preservative coatings and spice mixes. The butcher wants them for a new recipe.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: I am testing a new curing mix, and what I need most are Centipede stingers. Bring me %s within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Ground Spider fangs can be used in special seasoning and preservation work. They are not used often, but shortages become a problem fast.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Spider fangs are not needed every day, but once they are gone, everything slows down. Bring me %s within %s.

lang|tensura_guild|dwarf_task.tensura_gu.en: Blade Tiger tails carry tough sinew and make a rare dish the butcher only serves to trusted customers. The material is hard to source, and the reward reflects that.

lang|tensura_guild|dialogue.tensura_guil.en: Blade Tiger tails are not something you find every day. Bring me %s within %s and I will pay you in gold.

lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.cr.en: The guild has received word that a cultivator workshop urgently needs a Void Refinement Pill for a dangerous breakthrough attempt. Craft 1 Void Refinement Pill and submit it before the deadline.
A sealed alchemy request has arrived at the guild, demanding a Mystic Void Elixir refined to a stable state. Craft 1 Mystic Void Elixir and bring it back for delivery.
An advanced practitioner is paying handsomely for a Giant Spirit Pill strong enough to support a major cultivation stage. Craft 1 Giant Spirit Pill and submit it to the guild.
A top-tier workshop wants to inspect a Hihiirokane Bone Golem as a model for elite autonomous guardians. Craft 1 Hihiirokane Bone Golem and turn it in before the order is withdrawn.
A fortified estate is commissioning an Adamantite Bone Golem durable enough to stand as a permanent defender. Craft 1 Adamantite Bone Golem and return to submit it.
The guild needs a completed Orichalcum Bone Golem for a defensive evaluation contract. Craft 1 Orichalcum Bone Golem and bring it back on time.
A client from the workshop district has requested a Pure Magisteel Bone Golem to test advanced magical reinforcement methods. Craft 1 Pure Magisteel Bone Golem and submit it.
A local defense supplier is short on compact constructs and wants a Mithril Bone Golem ready for field trials. Craft 1 Mithril Bone Golem and bring it in.
The guild workshop wants a High Magisteel Bone Golem to compare durability against recent combat reports. Craft 1 High Magisteel Bone Golem and submit it.
Even lower-grade constructs are in demand when patrol routes need more bodies on watch. Craft 1 Low Magisteel Bone Golem and return it to the guild.
The transport network is missing a stable Warp Core, and the guild needs a fresh one forged before repairs can continue. Craft 1 Warp Core and submit it.

lang|tensura_tno|tensura_tno.race_presti.en:
§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The scales of calamity must become your armor. Prove your worth through craft and earth-shaking power.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Illusions, allure, and sacred flame define your path. Become the true mystic fox.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The spiritual essence of heaven and earth converges upon you. Command all spirits with the power of your contract and prove yourself the supreme Heavenly Fox Sovereign.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The winds, tides, flames, and storms answer your call. Master them all.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You serve darkness no longer, you command it... But to claim your rightful throne you need more strength.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The beastial blood that flows in your veins yearns for the hunt.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You seek redemption, but at what cost?
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4A weak lizard no longer, you seek a challenge befitting your new draconic body.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You seek perfection of your craft, its time to create your magnum opus.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You feel immense spiritual energy beckon you
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You heart and spirit craves battle, you want nothing more than to prove yourself, but to what?
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You dominate all things oceanic and aquatic, you'd like the keep it that way.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The ground quakes beneath you with each step. You seek to challenge those befitting your gigantic stature.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You desire strength and the subjugation of monsters as is your human nature.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4This world is brutal, but so are you.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You are determined to succeed where others have failed.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You hunger for control and power and will not let anyone stand in your way.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You feel a strange compulsion to grow your following, and protect them no matter the cost.
§r

lang|tensura_tno|tensura_tno.race_presti.en:
§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You have descended to the ultimate void. Prove that you can make the world tremble at your wrath.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4King of fangs, lord of the starry sea. Let the ancient wolves howl across the heavens at your stride.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Forge yourself anew in steel and curse. Let the doll's heart devour all that stands in your path.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4You are the ultimate fusion of chaos and metal. Forge, twist, reshape — let entropy be your form.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Highest seraph of the heavens — holy light and divine majesty are yours to command. Prove yourself worthy of the angelic apex.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Fallen from the heavens, your shattered wings now measure a world that no longer belongs to the light.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Sovereign of spirits — every element bows to your call. Prove you can wield the four winds with grace.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The supreme majin elemental. Element and demon-kind have become one — even fate yields before you.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Forged of eternal frost and the ocean abyss. Command the ancient frozen depths.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Frostblight Hydra — a thousand cold curses pour from your maws. Spread the icy plague.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4The Sun Deity Loong — soaring through the ninth heavens. Let solar flames burn away all who oppose your ascent.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Scorchtalon Wyvern — sovereign of the burning skies. Forge your totem from the embers of the flame.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Heavenly Restriction — a mortal body honed to its absolute limit. Without magicules, you still ascend.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4An existence beyond phantom and angel. Master both lies and truth — you will become a new tier of being.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Tengu — sovereign of mountain and forest. With wind as blade and heart as mirror, cleave through all illusions.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Excelsius — once forgotten, now exalted above all. Stand proud at the apex of fate.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Inferius — you have embraced void and hunger entire. Let abyssal craving consume the world.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Fire Ant — the throne of your hive burns. Prove you deserve the crown of flame.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Hardshell Ant — telluric power forged into your carapace. Let the earth speak of your weight.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Stag Beetle — the perfect union of strength and royalty.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Drone Beetle — thunder is your pulse.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Blue Centipede — tides and frigid springs answer your call.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Purple Centipede — spatial distortion is your fang.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Yellow Centipede — venom and paralysis are your blessing.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Lixivant Mantis — all things may be dissolved into nothing.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Preying Mantis — steel blades are your limbs.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Loxodrome Scorpion — your whisper is incurable poison.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Singularity Scorpion — you bend gravity and collapse to your will.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Queen Wasp — countless soldiers dance to your will.
§r

§r
§5§lRace Prestige
§4Divine Army Wasp — wind and blade weave your banner across the sky.
§r

You are not inside any barrier
§bContainment§r: Prevent normal exit of the barrier
§bBlock Entry§r: Prevent normal entry into the barrier
§bProjectile Shield§r: Absorbs projectiles that hit the barrier
§bReflect Projectiles§r: Reflects projectiles that hit the barrier
§bProtect Blocks§r: Blocks inside can't be broken by others
§bSpatial Lock§r: Teleports and warps can't bypass the barrier
§bStructural Integrity§r: Each level reduces the HP a barrier loses from its size by §6%1$s§r
§bDistortion Field§r: Stops spatial attacks (which normally bypass barriers)

§bClash§r: Barriers overlapping yours that aren't allied take §6%1$s§r damage every §6%2$ss§r, §6+%3$s§r per level. A barrier does damage in proportion to its §bsize§r, so casting a small barrier is not always optimal. Keeping the barrier up also costs §6%4$s%%§r of your own maximum health each exchange
§bThorns§r: Anything the barrier keeps in or out takes §6%1$s§r damage per level when it touches the wall, at most once every §6%2$ss§r. Only works with §bContainment§r or §bBlock Entry§r
§bElemental Resistance§r: Pick an element, the barrier takes §6%1$s§r less damage from that chosen element
§bMagicule Regen Down§r: Cuts magicule regen by §6%1$s§r/level; caster at §6%2$s§r strength
§bAura Regen Down§r: Cuts aura regen by §6%1$s§r/level; caster at §6%2$s§r strength
§bRegen Down§r: Cuts all healing inside by §6%1$s§r/level
§bDisable Nullifications§r: Toggles all nullifications off, including the caster
§bMagic Jamming§r: Reduces aspectual & spiritual magic damage by §6%1$s§r/level
§bMultilayer§r: Adds layers to a barrier, HP is split between these layers. Every broken layer passes §6%1$s§r of its max HP to the next
§bSound Isolation§r: Sound (and chat) can't pass the wall in either direction
§bAstral Bind§r: Spiritual beings or players with divinity can't escape
§bSuppress Spawns§r: Hostile mobs never spawn inside

§bDominion§r%1$s: Temporarily acquire §eVirtue§r skills from those inside; copy an §eAngelic§r §cUltimate§r if its holder has no more than §6%2$s§r more EP than you; lock others from using their §eAngelic§r §cUltimates§r unless they have at least §6%3$sx§r your EP; foes under §6%4$s§r of your EP are marked allies

§bEmbracing Drain§r%1$s: Everything in the barrier's containment filter loses §6%2$s§r of its magicules and aura every §6%3$ss§r, and is stunned for §6%4$ss§r each time energy is taken. Once a captive is at §6%5$s§r of either magicules or aura, there is a §6%6$s§r chance every §6%7$ss§r to call down §5Death Blessing§r

§bEnrage§r%1$s: Every hostile or non allied player inside gives you a §6%2$s§r chance every §6%3$ss§r to gain a level of §cRampage§r for §6%4$ss§r. At §cRampage %5$s§r it inverts: every §6%6$ss§r the barrier inflicts §cRampage§r on everyone inside instead, up to level §6%7$s§r

§bDeep Sleep§r%1$s: Your hits inside deal §6%2$s§r extra spiritual damage. You bypass spiritual attack resistance, spiritual attack nullification is treated as resistance. Non-allied players chant at §6%3$s§r speed and are given §5Drowsiness %4$s§r

§bNuclear Bomb§r%1$s: When below §6%2$s§r health the barrier gains §6+1§r charges every §6%3$ss§r (max §6%4$s§r). When it breaks it detonates destroying §6%5$s§r blocks and causes §6%6$s§r damage, +§6%7$s§r block and §6%8$s§r damage per charge. Needs §6%9$s§r Fusionist matter
§bBattlefield§r%1$s: Allies inside gain §6+%2$s§r attack, speed, and health. A §6%3$s§r auto dodge, and a §6%4$s§r chance for their attacks to pierce enemy dodges

§bLast Chance§r%1$s: The first ally who would die inside is restored to §6%2$s§r health, their magicules and aura are restored to §6%3$s§r and are granted §6%4$ss§r of invulnerability. This effect can only happen once per barrier and that ally waits §6%5$s min§r before it can activate again. Allies under §6%6$s§r health get §cStrength %7$s§r, §6+%8$s§r attack speed, §6+%9$s§r movement speed and §6+%10$s§r swim speed

§bIndestructible Wall§r%1$s: §6+%2$s§r barrier HP. §6%3$s§r of any damage done to allies inside is instead dealt to §cyourself§r. This barrier is incapable of saving allies from spiritual damage. Allies inside gain +§6%4$s§r armor and §6+%5$s§r knockback resistance

§bTakeover§r%1$s: Your hits have a §6%2$s§r chance to seize §6%3$s§r of the target's magicules, and a §6%4$s§r chance (§6%5$ss§r cooldown) to plunder one common, extra or aspectual magic from anyone whose EP is no more than §6%6$s00%%§r of yours. Summons inside whose owner is at or under §6%7$s00%%§r your EP become yours

§bReflector§r%1$s: Melee damage directed at the barrier returns §6%2$s§r of its damage to the attacker. Projectiles are sent back at §6%3$sx§r damage and §6%4$sx§r speed, homing onto whoever fired them. However this barrier only has §6%5$s§r of the usual HP

§bAcceleration§r%1$s: All non-magic damage inside the barrier becomes §cflame§r damage. Each crit you land (§6%2$ss§r cooldown) grants a §6Boost§r, boost give §6+%3$s§r movement speed and §6+%4$s§r projectile speed each lvl, however you lose 1 boost every §6%5$ss§r. Starting from §6Boost %6$s§r you radiate an aura of heat for §6%7$s§r damage every §6%8$ss§r with a radius of §6%9$s§r blocks, increasing by §6+%10$s§r per level. At §6Boost %11$s§r the wall cannot contain the heat and bursts. Trigger a §6%12$s§r block explosion for §6%13$s§r flame damage.

§bFamily Bond§r%1$s: Up to §6%2$s§r allies inside split the barrier's upkeep with you. An ally at or below §6%3$s§r of their magicules stops paying and their share returns to you. Players are picked before other entities

§bFull Counter§r%1$s: Any projectile that would hit you while inside the barrier is swallowed by the barrier and it's damage is stored. §6%2$ss§r after the first shot is caught, the wall releases everything it holds at §6%3$sx§r the damage, this damage is split evenly among the entities inside.

lang|traddon|traddon.skill.photon_blade..en: Summon a blade of pure light that can cut through almost anything. The blade's power increases with the user's mastery of the skill.

lang|traddon|traddon.skill.resonant_core.en: The golem's core is a unique crystalline structure that resonates with the world's magic. By attuning to this core, the golem can temporarily enhance its abilities, gaining increased strength, speed, and magical resistance for a short duration.

lang|traddon|traddon.skill.total_reflect.en: A unique skill that allows the user to reflect and absorb incoming attacks, converting them into stored energy for future use.

lang|traddon|traddon.race.shardling.desc.en: A small, floating cluster of jagged crystals held together by a faint magnetic core. They are often mistaken for raw ore until they move.

lang|traddon|traddon.race.geode_golem.de.en: The crystals have grown into a humanoid shape. Their chest cavity contains a hollow "Heart" filled with glowing, liquid magicules

lang|traddon|traddon.race.prism_knight.d.en: A towering figure clad in armor made of interlocking crystal plates that refract light into dazzling displays. They wield a massive crystalline sword that can cut through almost anything.

lang|traddon|traddon.race.diamond_sovere.en: A being of pure, blinding light contained within a diamond-hard exterior. They no longer "walk"; they exist as a focal point of the worlds laws.

lang|twilightforest|gui.twilightforest.o.en:
Before proceeding, please note that Optifine is known to cause crashes, multipart entity visual bugs and many other issues.

Before reporting a bug, please remove Optifine first and check again to see if the bug is still present.

Optifine-related issues are not solvable on Twilight Forest's end!

This screen may be disabled in the Client Config.
Here's a selection of mods that we recommend using instead.

lang|twilightforest|gui.twilightforest.p.en: This is the end of progression for now. The Final Castle that awaits on the plateau is still unfinished and a work in progress. If you would like to keep up with the mod's development you can join our %s.
